columns.Name: DERIVED_BILL_RATE
columns.Comments: Unit price in bill transaction currency, derived from the bill rate setup for rate-based contract lines, used to calculate the derived potential amount in bill transaction currency. For all other applicable sources of bill transaction the unit price for revenue recognition and invoicing are stored in TRNS_CURR_REV_UNIT_PRICE and TRNS_CURR_INV_UNIT_PRICE respectively.

columns.Name: DERIVED_DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.Comments: Discount percentage, derived from the bill rate setup for rate-based contract lines, used to calculate the derived bill amount.

columns.Name: DERIVED_LABOR_MULTIPLIER
columns.Comments: Multiplier, derived from the bill rate setup for rate-based contract lines, used in conjunction with labor cost to calculate the derived bill amount.

columns.Name: DERIVED_MARKUP_PERCENTAGE
columns.Comments: Markup percentage, derived from the bill rate setup for rate-based contract lines, used to calculate the derived bill amount.

columns.Name: DERIVED_TRNS_CURR_TXN_AMT
columns.Comments: Potential amount to be billed in bill transaction currency, prior to applying the contract contribution percentage and performing billing control limit checking.

columns.Name: INV_GROUP_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES
columns.Comments: List of attribute values, based on the attributes specified on the applicable invoice format and separated by a delimiter, used to group transactions into invoice lines.

columns.Name: INV_GROUP_ATTRIBUTE_DESC
columns.Comments: List of attribute names, as specified on the applicable invoice format and separated by a delimiter, used to group transactions into invoice lines.

columns.Name: INV_LINE_DESCRIPTION
columns.Comments: Formatted combination of attribute values and text that describes the products, projects, services or goods being charged to the customer on each line of an invoice.

columns.Name: APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicator whether the bill transaction is applicable for invoicing, revenue recognition, or both.

columns.Name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the set containing the source transaction related to this bill transaction. For example, where a bill transaction relates to a project cost transaction, this is the identifier of the expenditure batch.

columns.Name: PREPROCESS_STATUS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicator whether the bill transaction is pending rate derivation or ready for invoicing and/or revenue recognition.

columns.Name: USER_ADJUSTED_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicator whether the amounts derived by the application, such as bill rate, bill quantity or bill amount, have been overridden by a user.

columns.Name: CONT_CURR_INV_DATE_TYPE
columns.Comments: Indicator of which date, the transaction date, transaction accounting date, or a user-specified fixed date, to use when converting various invoice amounts from bill transaction currency to contract currency.

columns.Name: SYSTEM_LINKAGE_FUNCTION
columns.Comments: Classification of the source transactionâs expenditure type, used to control invoicing or revenue recognition for the entire class.

columns.Name: BILLING_STATUS_CODE
columns.Comments: The billing status of the bill transaction.

columns.Name: TRNS_CURR_WIP_AMT
columns.Comments: The amount remaining to be billed in bill transaction currency, This amount is also referred to as the work-in-progress (or WIP) amount.

columns.Name: TRNS_CURR_CNTRB_PCT_TXN_AMT
columns.Comments: The potential amount to be billed in transaction currency, after applying the contract contribution percentage.

columns.Name: PREPAYMENT_INDICATOR
columns.Comments: Indicates whether the bill transaction is a Prepayment Request or Prepayment Application. This column will have values R(Prepayment Request), A(Prepayment Application), N or Null (Not a Prepayment Request or Application).

columns.Name: STATUS_REASON_CODE
columns.Comments: Provides additional context as to why a transaction is in a particular status. Where the status of a transaction has been explicitly changed by a user, such as changing the transaction status from 'On hold' to 'Ready', the status reason is chosen by the user who performs the action.

columns.Name: PROSPECTIVE_INVOICE_DATE
columns.Comments: The date on which a transaction can automatically be added to a draft invoice.

columns.Name: DERIVED_QUANTITY
columns.Comments: The original quantity to bill derived by the application, prior to any adjustments.

columns.Name: PRICING_TYPE_CODE
columns.Comments: Code indicating the type of pricing used to calculate the amount to bill.

columns.Name: INITIAL_BILLING_STS_DERIVED
columns.Comments:
Tracks whether the initial value of the billing status attribute was derived using configurable business rules. Possible values of this column are: 
                                 Y - The initial value of the billing status attribute was derived using configurable business rules.
                                 N - The initial value of the billing status attribute has not yet been derived using configurable business rules.
                                 NA - The initial value of the billing status attribute was not derived as no business rules were configured.
                                 NULL - The initial value of the billing status attribute was not derived as the transaction was created prior to the introduction of the Configurable Bill Transaction Initial Status Derivation Rules feature, and prior to opting into the Bill Transaction Creation on Cost Import feature.

columns.Name: BILL_GROUP
columns.Comments: Free-text string tag which influences how the transactions are grouped into invoices. Transactions within the same bill group are included on the same invoice, subject to all other invoice grouping logic.

columns.Name: BILL_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.Comments: Classification of the Billing method.

columns.Name: REVENUE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Revenue process use this method for create revenue if enable

columns.Comments: Show type of Invoice. Standard/Credit Memo/Write-Off/Net Invoice/Canceled

columns.Comments: Identifier of set of invoices created together in the same run which must be released at the same time

columns.Name: BILL_FROM_DATE
columns.Comments: The date through which to invoice the project. Expenditure items with the expenditure item date on or after the bill from date and events with completion dates on or after the bill through date may be included on an invoice.

columns.Name: BILL_TO_DATE
columns.Comments: The date through which to invoice the project. Expenditure items with the expenditure item date on or before the bill to date and events with completion dates on or before the bill through date may be included on an invoice.

columns.Comments: The date reported on the invoice as the date from which transactions are included on an invoice.

columns.Name: REPORTED_TO_DATE

columns.Comments: Flag that indicates that an error was encountered during the Generate Draft Invoices program that caused the draft invoice to not be successfully generated

columns.Name: PA_DATE
columns.Comments: The end date of the PA period in which the invoice was generated. The PA period is the open or future PA period on or after the latest date of the expenditure item dates and the event completion dates included on the invoice.

columns.Name: INVOICE_COMMENT
columns.Comments: Free text comments that can be printed on an invoice. The invoice comment is defaulted from the invoice comment defined for the project. This value can be overridden by a user for each draft invoice

columns.Name: INVOICE_INSTRUCTIONS

columns.Comments: The date that the draft invoice was released for transfer

columns.Comments: The identifier of the employee that released the invoice

columns.Name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.Comments: The invoice date passed to Oracle Receivables which is used to calculate the invoice due date. Upon release of the invoice, this date is defaulted from the released date. The user can override the invoice date at the time of release

columns.Name: RA_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.Comments: The Oracle Receivables invoice number that is determined upon release of the draft invoice and passed to Oracle Receivables upon transfer. This number can be user-entered or system-generated as defined in the implementation options.

columns.Name: TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
columns.Comments: The status of the invoice as it is transferred to Oracle Receivables

columns.Name: TRANSFERRED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date that the draft invoice was transferred to the Oracle Receivables interface tables

columns.Name: TRANSFER_REJECT_REASON_CODE
columns.Comments: The reason why the draft invoice was rejected by the Transfer Invoice program or rejected by Oracle Receivables AutoInvoice interface program

columns.Name: GL_DATE
columns.Comments: The date within a GL accounting period to which the invoice transactions are posted. The GL date is set by the Transfer Invoice program and is the date of the first future or open GL period in Oracle Receivables of the invoice date.

columns.Name: SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.Comments: The reference to the invoice created in Oracle Receivables from the draft invoice. The column is populated by Tieback Invoice and holds the RA_CUSTOMER_TRX.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID

columns.Name: CANCELLED_FLAG
columns.Comments: Flag that indicates that the draft invoice was credited by another draft invoice, a credit memo

columns.Name: CONVERTED_FLAG
columns.Comments: Flag indicating if the invoice is converted. 'Y' denotes a converted invoice with no detail in AR as PA expects. A value of 'N' or null denotes a non-converted invoice. A converted invoice cannot be cancelled or written off.

columns.Name: ACCTD_CURRENCY_CODE

columns.Comments: Accounted currency exchange rate for the draft invoices generated for this project customer.

columns.Name: CREDIT_MEMO_REASON_CODE

columns.Comments: Indicates whether the event type is a Prepayment Request or Prepayment Application. This column will have values R(Prepayment Request), A(Prepayment Application), N or Null. columns.Name: CALC_RAW_COST_FLAG
columns.Comments: Flag that indicates Raw cost calculation is required, raw cost calculated but currency conversion required, cost calculation not required. Possible Values are:Y - Calculate raw cost and convert cost into the required currency C - Raw cost is available and only currency conversion is required N - Raw cost calculation is not required. Note: Flag pricing not required for reversals of the costed expenditure items. Because cost of these items are reversals of the original items.Flag pricing not required for transaction source that import burden cost from external system. Determine the burden cost for these transactions by pro rating the burden cost for transaction source that import burden cost from external system. Flag pricing not required for BTC summarized transactions.

columns.Name: CALC_IND_COST_FLAG
columns.Comments: Flag that indicates Burden cost calculation is required, Burden cost is calculated but currency conversion pending, Burden cost calculation is not requiredPossible Values are: Y - Calculate raw cost and convert cost into the required currency C - Raw cost is available and only currency conversion is required N - Raw cost calculation is not required.Note: Flag pricing not required for reversals of the costed expenditure items. Because cost of these items are reversals of the original items.Flag pricing not required for transaction source that import burden cost from external system. Determine the burden cost for these transactions by pro rating the burden cost for transaction source that import burden cost from external system. Flag pricing not required for BTC summarized transactions

columns.Name: PROJECT_PLAN_VIEW_ACCESS
columns.Comments: Access level to the view-only project plan in Oracle Fusion Task Management. Example values are ALL_USERS and PROJECT_TEAM.

columns.Name: INTEGRATED_PRODUCT_CODE
columns.Comments: The identifier of the external project management system from which the project is integrated.

columns.Name: INTEGRATED_PROJECT_REFERENCE
columns.Comments: The identifier of the project in the external project management system from which the project is integrated.

columns.Name: WORKFLOW_COUNTER
columns.Comments: If project statuses have been configured to have one workflow-enabled status transition to another workflow-enabled status, this column stores a numeric counter that increments with each transition. If the counter value in this column exceeds 10, the workflow will terminate and return the project to the last status that was not workflow enabled (stored in the column INITIAL_WF_STATUS_CODE). This is a failsafe mechanism to protect against infinite loops.

columns.Name: INITIAL_WF_STATUS_CODE
columns.Comments: When a project is transitioned to a workflow-enabled status, this column records the last status that was not workflow enabled. If the approval workflow completes in error, the project will be returned to this status. For example, if the configuration of project statuses and workflow rules result in a loop, and the number of iterations of the loop exceed 10, the workflow will exit and return the project to this status.

columns.Name: AUTO_ASSET_CREATE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether project assets will be automatically created for projects associated with a capitalizable project type.

columns.Name: AUTO_ASSET_LINE_ALLOCATE_MODE
columns.Comments: Indicates the project costs that will be allocated for the automatically created project assets.

columns.Name: LANGUAGE
columns.Comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.Name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.Comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.Name: EXECUTION_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the execution project customer

columns.Name: XFACE_REC_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the project in the interface table.

columns.Name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_CODE
columns.Comments: The third-party application from which the project originates. The application code must be defined in the Source Application lookup type. If a value is not entered, the source application code is set to OPEN_INTERFACE.

columns.Name: SOURCE_PROJECT_REFERENCE
columns.Comments: The identifier of the project in the external system where it was originally entered.

columns.Name: SOURCE_TEMPLATE_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Number of the project template used to create the current project.

columns.Name: PROJECT_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the project to be imported. A value is required.

columns.Name: PROJECT_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Number of the project to be imported. This value is required if project numbering is not automatic.

columns.Name: ORGANIZATION_NAME
columns.Comments: Organization that owns the project. Organizations can be departments, sections, divisions, companies, or other units.

columns.Name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.Comments: Legal entity that owns the project.  A recognized party with given rights and responsibilities by legislation.

columns.Name: DESCRIPTION
columns.Comments: A description about the project. This might include high-level information about the work being performed.

columns.Name: PROJECT_MANAGER_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Number of the person who leads the project team and who has authority and responsibility for meeting project objectives. This project manager overrides the project manager copied from the template. The project manager number takes precedence over the project manager name and  E-Mail.

columns.Name: PROJECT_MANAGER_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the person who leads the project team and who has authority and responsibility for meeting project objectives. The value must match the format of the list name, which is last name followed by a comma, space, and first name. This project manager overrides the project manager copied from the template. This value is not used if the project manager number is entered. The project manager name takes precedence over the project manager E-Mail.

columns.Name: PROJECT_MANAGER_EMAIL
columns.Comments: E-Mail address of the person who leads the project team and who has authority and responsibility for meeting project objectives. This project manager overrides the project manager copied from the template. This value is not used if the project manager number or name is entered.

columns.Name: PROJECT_START_DATE
columns.Comments: The date that work or information tracking begins on a project. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: PROJECT_FINISH_DATE
columns.Comments: The date that work or information tracking completes for a project. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: CLOSED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date that the project status was set to closed. No further action can be taken on closed projects. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: PROJECT_STATUS_NAME
columns.Comments: An implementation-defined classification of the status of a project. Typical project status names are Active and Closed.

columns.Name: PROJECT_PRIORITY_CODE
columns.Comments: The importance of a project based on a predefined scale. The code must be defined in the Project Priority lookup type. Examples include HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW.

columns.Name: OUTLINE_DISPLAY_LEVEL
columns.Comments: The level to which the project plan is expanded by default when you navigate to the project plan. For example, if the value is 3, the project plan is expanded to 3 levels. If the value is 0, the project is collapsed.

columns.Name: PLANNING_PROJECT_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates the project is used to plan and schedule tasks and resources on those tasks. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: SERVICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.Comments: A classification of the service or activity associated with the project. The code must be defined in the Service Type lookup type.

columns.Name: WORK_TYPE_NAME
columns.Comments: A classification of the work associated with a project or task.. You can use work types to categorize and group projects for processing purposes.

columns.Name: PROJECT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.Comments: The three-letter ISO currency code of the project to which the transaction is charged.

columns.Name: CURRENCY_CONV_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.Comments:
Dates that can be used when converting amounts to the project currency. Valid values are:

A - Accounting Date
P - Project Accounting Date
T - Transaction Date
F - Fixed Date"

columns.Name: CURRENCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.Comments: The source of a currency conversion rate, such as user defined, spot, or corporate. In this case, the rate determines how to convert an amount from one currency to the project currency.

columns.Name: CURRENCY_CONV_DATE
columns.Comments: The date used to obtain currency conversion rates when converting an amount to the project currency. This date is used when the currency conversion date type is Fixed Date. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: BURDEN_SCHEDULE_NAME
columns.Comments: Default set of overhead cost multipliers for the project.

columns.Name: BURDEN_SCH_FIXED_DATED
columns.Comments: A specific date used to determine the right set of burden multipliers for the project. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: KPI_NOTIFICATION_ENABLED
columns.Comments: Indicates that workflow notifications are sent after KPI values are generated. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: KPI_NOTIFICATION_INCLUDE_NOTES
columns.Comments: Indicates that notes about the KPI are included on the KPI generation notification report. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: KPI_NOTIFICATION_RECIPIENTS
columns.Comments: Indicates that workflow notifications are sent to the project manager after KPI values are generated. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: CINT_ELIGIBLE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates the project is enabled for capitalization of interest amounts. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: CINT_RATE_SCH_NAME
columns.Comments: The rate schedule used to calculate the capitalized interest.

columns.Name: CINT_STOP_DATE
columns.Comments: The date where capitalized interest will stop accruing. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: ASSET_ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.Comments:
Method by which unassigned asset lines and common costs are allocated across multiple assets. Valid code values are:

AU - Actual units
CC - Current cost
EC - Estimated cost
SC - Standard unit cost
SE - Spread evenly
CE - Client extension
N - None

columns.Name: CAPITAL_EVENT_PROCESSING_CODE
columns.Comments:
Name of the method for processing events on projects of this project type if capitalization is enabled. Valid code values:

M - Manual
P - Periodic
N - None"

columns.Name: ALLOW_CROSS_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.Comments: An option at the project and task level to indicate if transaction charges are allowed from all provider business units to the project or task. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: CC_PROCESS_LABOR_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates that the project will allow processing of cross-charge transactions between business units for labor transactions. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: LABOR_TP_SCHEDULE_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the transfer price schedule that associates transfer price rules with pairs of provider and receiver organizations for labor transactions.

columns.Name: LABOR_TP_FIXED_DATE
columns.Comments: A specific date used to determine a price on a transfer price schedule for labor transactions. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: CC_PROCESS_NL_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates that the project will allow processing of cross-charge transactions between business units for nonlabor transactions. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.Name: NL_TP_SCHEDULE_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the transfer price schedule that associates transfer price rules with pairs of provider and receiver organizations for nonlabor transactions.

columns.Name: NL_TP_FIXED_DATE
columns.Comments: A specific date used to determine a price on a transfer price schedule for nonlabor transactions. The date format is YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.Name: LIMIT_TO_TXN_CONTROLS_CODE
columns.Comments:
Type of transaction controls, inclusive or exclusive, defined for the selected project or task. Valid code values are:

Y - Inclusive
N - Exclusive

columns.Name: COPY_TASKS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether project tasks are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. If the value is Y, tasks in the open interface file are not loaded. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_TASK_ATTACHMENTS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether task attachments are copied from the project template when tasks are copied. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_TASK_DFF_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether task descriptive flexfields are copied from the project template when tasks are copied. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_TASK_ASSIGNMENTS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether task attachments are copied from the project template when tasks are copied. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_TEAM_MEMBERS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether project team members are copied from the originating project template to the new project. A project team member is a person who is assigned a role on a project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_PROJECT_CLASSES_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether project classifications should be copied from the originating project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_ASSETS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether assets are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_ASSET_ASSIGNMENTS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether asset assignments are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_TRANSACTION_CONTROLS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether transaction controls are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. If the value is Y, transaction controls in the open interface file are not loaded. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_GROUP_SPACE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether the project space template is copied from the originating template to the project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_DFF_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether descriptive flexfields are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_ATTACHMENTS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether attachments are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Name: COPY_COST_OVERRIDES_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether costing overrides are copied from the project template to the new project. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N.

columns.Comments: Flag to indicate whether cross charge are allowed

columns.Comments: Flag that indicates cross charge processing is to be performed for labor transactions charged to the project. Default value for the project template is N. This is defaulted to a project from the project template. This value for the project is a default for the task fixed date

columns.Name: RECEIVE_PROJECT_INVOICE_FLAG

columns.Name: CC_PROCESS_NL_FLAG

columns.Name: RA_TASK_DATES_SAME
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Set Task Assignment the same as task date" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The valid values are `Y' and `N'. If the value is `Y', then task assignment dates will always be same as the task planning dates.

columns.Name: AUTO_ROLLUP_TASK_DATE
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Automatically rollup task dates" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The valid values are `Y' and `N'. If the value is `Y' then the task dates are rolled up to the hierarchy.

columns.Name: SYNC_TASK_TXN_PLAN_DATES
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Synchronize task transaction dates with plan dates" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The valid values are `Y' and `N'. If the value is `Y', the task transaction dates will be same as the task planning dates.

columns.Name: SYNC_TXN_DATE_BUFFER
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Date adjustment buffer" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The value is used in conjunction with the above sync up column.

columns.Name: GEN_BDGT_DURING_BASELINE
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Generate budget version when setting baseline for project plan" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The valid values are `Y' and `N'. If the value is `Y', the generate budget API is called during the project plan baseline.

columns.Name: RA_PLAN_TYPE_ID
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Financial Plan Type" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The valid financial plan types are shown in the single select drop down. The valid value consists of COST_ONLY plan types. These are used while generating a budget during the project plan baseline. This column will have value only if the column GEN_BUDG_DURING_BASELINE is `Y'.

columns.Name: AUTO_BDGT_BASELINE
columns.Comments: This corresponds to the "Automatically designate budget version as baseline" field in the project plan type's Task Settings tab. The valid values are `Y' and `N'. If the value is `Y', the generated budget should be baselined as well during the project plan baseline. This column will have value only if the column GEN_BUDG_DURING_BASELINE is `Y'.

columns.Name: TOTAL_HOURS
columns.Comments:
The total number of hours that are assigned to the resource for a project resource assignment. The hours are calculated differently depending on the value of USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG:
Y=Number of working days in the project calendar multiplied by the number of hours in each working day in the project calendar.
N=Number of working days in the project calendar multiplied by number of hours per day on the project resource assignment.
X=Based on working hours of specific day of week specified in the resource assignment.
W=Based on weekly hours specified in the assignment multiplied by number of working weeks during assignment start date and end date per project calendar.

N â  Specified daily hours in HOURS_PER_DAY column

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier of implementation options that apply across Oracle Fusion Project Resource Management.

columns.Name: SUBTRACT_PTO_ABS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Option that, when selected, will subtract absences and paid time off from total capacity in resource utilization calculations.

columns.Name: PROJ_RESOURCE_REQ_FLAG
columns.Comments: Option that, when selected, enables project resource request workflow to notify the staffing owner of a project resource request when the request is submitted for fulfillment.

columns.Name: PROJ_RESOURCE_REQ_CANCEL_FLAG
columns.Comments: Option that, when selected, enables project resource request workflow to notify the participants that a project resource request is canceled by the staffing owner.

columns.Name: PROJ_RESOURCE_PROP_FLAG
columns.Comments: Option that, when selected, enables project resource approval workflow to require requester approval when a resource is proposed to fulfill a project resource request.

columns.Name: PROJ_ASSIGN_NOTIFY_FLAG
columns.Comments: Option that, when selected, enables project resource approval workflow to send notification to the resource when a resource assignment is confirmed, updated or cancelled.

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_PERCENTAGE
columns.Comments: Percentage from 0 to 100 that defines the default target utilization percentage for the enterprise.

columns.Name: ALLOW_REQ_ASG_DTS_OUTSIDE_PRJ
columns.Comments: Indicates if project resource request or assignment is allowed to have start date before project start date and/or end date after project end date, basically allowing a project resource request or assignment to be outside of its project dates on either end.

columns.Name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.Comments: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.Name: SEC_RES_FLAG
columns.Comments: Option that when selected, secures resources from project resource pools across Oracle Fusion Project Resource Management.

columns.Name: ACT_HRS_SRC
columns.Comments: Source of actual hours. A value of 'ORA_PJR_PROJECT_COSTING' indicates that the source of actual hours is Oracle Fusion Project Costing Application.'ORA_PJR_SPREADSHEET_IMPORT' indicates that the source is a spreadsheet.

columns.Name: REQUEST_FULFILLMENT_MODE
columns.Comments: Implementation option that indicates how resource requests can be fulfilled. NP indicates that requests can be fulfilled either by nominating or proposing resources. N indicates that requests can only be fulfilled by nominating resources.

columns.Name: AVAILABILITY_SCORE_SOURCE
columns.Comments: Type of assignment data for calculating the availability score. The possible values are All assignments and nonproject event, Billable assignment only, and Billable assignments and nonproject events.

columns.Name: ALLOW_OVERBOOK_BILLABLE_ASSIGN
columns.Comments: Indicates if overbooking of billable assignments is allowed.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_REJECT_REASON_CODE

columns.Name: STAFF_OWNER_FR_POOL_OWNER_MGR

columns.Name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates that the object status is predefined by Oracle.

columns.Name: SYSTEM_FLOW
columns.Comments: Indicates the system flow in which this status can be used. For example NOM_FLOW indicates this status is used in the nominate resource flow.

columns.Name: INITIAL_STATUS_FLAG

columns.Name: NEXT_ALLOWABLE_STATUS_FLAG

columns.Name: PROCESS_ORDER
columns.Comments: Order in which to process a condition in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources. Conditions with a lower number are processed first.

columns.Name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the calendar to assign to resources in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: PROJECT_ROLE_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the project role to assign to resources in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: COST_RATE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency to assign to resources for the cost rate in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: BILL_RATE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency to assign to resources for the bill rate in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: COST_RATE
columns.Comments: Cost rate to assign to resources in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: BILL_RATE
columns.Comments: Bill rate to assign to resources in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.Comments: Unit of Measure.

columns.Name: POOL_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the project resource pool to which a resource is assigned.

columns.Name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.Comments:
Identifier of the business unit that determine which HCM people are included in
the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources if the condition
selects HCM people based on their business unit.

columns.Name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.Comments:
Identifier of the organization that determine which HCM people are included in
the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources if the condition
selects HCM people based on their organization.

columns.Name: ENABLE_CONDITION_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates if the condition is included while importing persons from HCM as part of  Maintain Project Enterprise Labor Resources process.

columns.Name: INCLUDE_ORG_HIERARCHY
columns.Comments: Indicates if the HCM persons are imported only from the selected organization or from the organization hierarchy.

columns.Name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.Comments: Identifier of the Tree Structure. Possible values are PER_DEPT_TREE_STRUCTURE or PER_ORG_TREE_STRUCTURE.

columns.Name: TREE_CODE
columns.Comments: Identifier of the Organization or Department Tree.

columns.Name: POSITION_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the position that determine which HCM people are included in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: LOCATION_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the location that determine which HCM people are included in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier of a labor resource condition for the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources. The enterprise ID uniquely identifies a tenant in a multi-tenant environment.

columns.Name: CONDITION_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier of a labor resource condition.

columns.Name: LANGUAGE
columns.Comments: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.Name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.Comments: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.Name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.Comments: Display name of the labor resource condition.

columns.Name: DESCRIPTION
columns.Comments: Description of the labor resource condition.

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier of a labor resource condition for the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources. The enterprise ID uniquely identifies a tenant in a multi-tenant environment.

columns.Name: CRITERIA_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier of a labor resource condition criteria.

columns.Name: CONDITION_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier of a labor resource condition.

columns.Name: JOB_ID
columns.Comments: List of identifiers of the jobs that determine which HCM people are included in the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources if the condition selects HCM people based on their job.

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier of the result detail of the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources. The enterprise ID uniquely identifies a tenant in a multi-tenant environment.

columns.Name: RESULT_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier of each exception encountered during the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: RESULT_LINE_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier of each exception line encountered. Used to differentiate identical values in the RESULT_ID column.

columns.Name: REQUEST_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.Name: PERSON_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the person for whom a resource exception was encountered during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: PERSON_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Number of the person for whom a resource exception was encountered during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.Comments: Message text that explains a resource exception that was encountered during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME1
columns.Comments: Token name used in a resource exception message that was generated during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE1
columns.Comments: Token value used in a resource exception message that was generated during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: TOKEN_DATA_TYPE1
columns.Comments: Token data type used in a resource exception message that was generated during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME2
columns.Comments: Token name used in a resource exception message that was generated during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE2
columns.Comments: Token value used in a resource exception message that was generated during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: TOKEN_DATA_TYPE2
columns.Comments: Token data type used in a resource exception message that was generated during the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: IMPORT_STATUS
columns.Comments: Status of HCM resources imported as project enterprise resources

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier of the result detail of the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources. The enterprise ID uniquely identifies a tenant in a multi-tenant environment.

columns.Name: RESULT_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier of the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: CHILD_REQUEST_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the child process initiated during the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: CREATE_NEW_FLAG
columns.Comments: Process option to create project enterprise labor resources based on the project enterprise labor resource maintenance conditions.

columns.Name: INACTIVE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Process option to deselect the option to manage resource availability and staffing for project enterprise labor resources who are associated with HCM persons who no longer have an active HCM assignment.

columns.Name: PROCESS_RUN_DATE
columns.Comments: Completion date and time of the last successfully-completed run of the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: TOTAL_RESOURCE_CREATED
columns.Comments: Number of resources that are created by the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: TOTAL_RESOURCE_UPDATED
columns.Comments: Number of resources that are updated by the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: TOTAL_RESOURCE_REJECTED
columns.Comments: Number of resource exceptions that are encountered by the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: TOTAL_RESOURCE_REMOVED
columns.Comments: Number of resources for whom the option to manage resource availability and staffing was deselected by the process to maintain project enterprise labor resources.

columns.Name: UPDATE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Process option to update project enterprise labor resources based on the project enterprise labor resource maintenance conditions.

columns.Name: UPDATE_PRJ_ENT_RES_DTLS_FLAG
columns.Comments: Process option to update additional details of project enterprise labor resources based on the values defined in project enterprise labor resource maintenance conditions.

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier that uniquely identifies a tenant in a multi-tenant environment.

columns.Name: POOL_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically generated unique identifier for a project resource pool.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the resource who owns a project resource pool.

columns.Name: FROM_DATE
columns.Comments: Date from which a project resource pool is active.

columns.Name: TO_DATE
columns.Comments: Date to which a project resource pool is active.

columns.Name: PARENT_POOL_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the parent resource pool. The parent pool ID is zero for the All Resources root pool.

columns.Name: POOL_TYPE_CODE
columns.Comments: Pool type classification that identifies the All Resources root pool with a pool type value of R, and Unassigned Resources pool with a pool type value of U. You must have one root pool and one pool for unassigned resources. The pool type value is null for all other pools.

columns.Name: POOL_CODE
columns.Comments: Unique alternate identifier for resource pool.

columns.Name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.Comments: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.Name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.Comments: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.Name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.Comments: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.Name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.Comments: Tree structure identifier. Foreign key to the FND_TREE_STRUCTURE table.

columns.Name: TREE_CODE
columns.Comments: Tree code identifier. Foreign key to the FND_TREE table.

columns.Name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.Comments: Tree version identifier. Foreign key to the FND_TREE_VERSION table.

columns.Name: CF_TREE_NODE_ID
columns.Comments: Tree node identifier. Foreign key to the FND_TREE_NODE table.

columns.Comments: Reason for which the project resource request was adjusted.

columns.Name: ADJUSTMENT_COMMENT
columns.Comments: Comment for the project resource request adjustment.

columns.Name: NEW_ASSIGN_HOURS_PER_DAY
columns.Comments:
Indicates whether the resource's assigned hours per day are based on the project calendar. A value of Y indicates the assigned hours 
per day are based on the project calendar. A value of N indicates the assigned hours per day are based on the value in the NEW_ASSIGN_HOURS_PER_DAY column.

columns.Name: NEW_ASSIGN_USE_CAL_FLAG
columns.Comments: The number of hours that a resource is assigned each working day during the assignment date range. NEW_ASSIGN_HOURS_PER_DAY can be greater than the default value of 0 only if the NEW_ASSIGN_USE_CAL_FLAG is value is N.

columns.Name: USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG
columns.Comments:
Indicates the option the resources assigned hours per day are based on:  
Y= Project calendar hours.
N= Specified hours in HOURS_PER_DAY column.
X= Variable hours in HOURS_PER_DAY1 - HOURS_PER_DAY7 columns.
W= Specified weekly hours in HOURS_PER_INTERVAL column.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY
columns.Comments: The number of hours that a resource is assigned each working day during the assignment date range. HOURS_PER_DAY can be greater than the default value of 0 only if the USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG is value is N.

columns.Name: TARGET_COST_RATE
columns.Comments: Cost rate that represents the targeted rate for the resource who will fulfill the request.

columns.Name: TARGET_BILL_RATE
columns.Comments: Bill rate that represents the targeted rate for the resource who will fulfill the request.

columns.Name: TARGET_COST_RATE_CURR_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency of the target cost rate for the request.

columns.Name: TARGET_BILL_RATE_CURR_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency of the target bill rate for the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_COST_RATE
columns.Comments: Cost rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_BILL_RATE
columns.Comments: Bill rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_COST_RATE_CURR_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency of the cost rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_BILL_RATE_CURR_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency of the bill rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: SUBMITTED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date a project resource request is submitted for fulfillment. The status of the project resource request changes from Draft to Open.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_PROPOSED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date a resource is proposed to fulfill a project resource request. The status of the project resource request changes from Open to Resource Proposed.

columns.Name: FULFILLED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date a resource is approved to fulfill a project resource request. If project manager approval is required, the fulfilled date is when the status of the request changes from Resource Proposed to Fulfilled. If approval is not required, the fulfilled date is when the status of the request changes from Open to Fulfilled.

columns.Name: WITHDRAWAL_DATE
columns.Comments: The date the request was last withdrawn. Value is null unless withdrawn.

columns.Name: TOTAL_HOURS
columns.Comments:
The total number of hours that are requested on a project resource request. The hours are calculated differently depending on the value of USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG:
Y= Number of working days in the project calendar multiplied by the number of hours in each working day in the project calendar.
N=Number of working days in the project calendar multiplied by number of hours per day on the project resource request.
X=Based on working hours of specific day of week specified in the resource request.
W=Based on weekly hours specified in the request multiplied by number of working weeks during requested start date and end date per project calendar.

columns.Name: NUMBER_OF_WORKING_DAYS
columns.Comments: The total number of working days that are requested on a project resource request. The number of working days is based on the working days in the project calendar for the requested date range. However, when USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG=X (variable hours), the number of working days are based on selected days of the week and not based on project calendar working days.

columns.Name: REQUEST_SOURCE
columns.Comments: Indicates the source of the project resource request. Valid values include PRS, Cloud, PM, Service, and RM. For example, PRS indicates that the request originated from the Manage Project Resources page, PM indicates that the source is the Manage Project Resource Requests page in the Project Management work area, and RM indicates that the source is the Manage Project Resource Requests page in the Project Resources work area.

columns.Name: REQUESTED_QUANTITY
columns.Comments: The requested quantity of resources needed for this resource request. If this request is for multiple resources then the number must be greater then one. The default value is one.

columns.Name: REMAINING_QUANTITY
columns.Comments: Indicates the remaining open resource quantity that has not been proposed or approved.

columns.Name: PROPOSED_QUANTITY
columns.Comments: Indicates the proposed resource quantity that has not been approved or rejected.

columns.Name: ASSIGNED_QUANTITY
columns.Comments: Indicates the assigned resource quantity that is approved.

columns.Name: CURRENT_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether the project resource request is the most recent request for the assignment.  A value of Y when the ASSIGN_ID column is blank indicates that the request is not fulfilled.  A value of Y when the ASSIGN_ID column contains a value indicates that the request is the most recently-approved adjustment request for the assignment.  A value of N indicates that there is a subsequent approved adjustment request for the assignment.

columns.Name: CREATED_FROM_FLOW
columns.Comments: Indicates the source create interface flow code.

columns.Name: LAST_UPDATED_FROM_FLOW
columns.Comments: Indicates the source update interface flow code.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY1
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Sunday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY2
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Monday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY3
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Tuesday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY4
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Wednesday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY5
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Thursday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY6
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Friday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY7
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Saturday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_INTERVAL
columns.Comments: Hours to be spread over the time interval specified in USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG.  For example, the column captures weekly hours when USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG=W

columns.Name: PRS_IN_SYNC_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates the resource from a project resource request is reflected as a project resource in project management.

columns.Name: STATUS_CODE_BKP
columns.Comments: Back up of status codes of a project resource request.

columns.Name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.Comments: Enterprise identifier that uniquely identifies a tenant in a multi-tenant environment.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_REQUEST_DETAIL_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier for a detail, such as a qualification, on a project resource request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_REQUEST_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier for a project resource request.

columns.Name: CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of a qualification on the project resource request. Oracle Fusion Project Resource Management supports the use of qualifications only from a subset of predefined qualification content types in Oracle Fusion Profile Management.

columns.Name: SECTION_ID
columns.Comments: Section ID of the content section the qualification content item is associated with. Foreign Key to HRT_PROFILE_TYP_SECTIONS

columns.Name: KEYWORD
columns.Comments: Keyword requirement for the project resource request. A requirement is a keyword when it is entered as text in the project resource request instead of selected from the list of qualifications from Oracle Fusion Profile Management.

columns.Name: RATING_LEVEL_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the proficiency rating level for a competency. The rating levels for the competency content type are defined in Oracle Fusion Profile Management.

columns.Name: READING_RATING_LEVEL_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the reading proficiency rating level for a language The rating levels for the language content type are defined in Oracle Fusion Profile Management.

columns.Name: WRITING_RATING_LEVEL_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the writing proficiency rating level for a language. The rating levels for the language content type are defined in Oracle Fusion Profile Management.

columns.Name: SPEAKING_RATING_LEVEL_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the speaking proficiency rating level for a language. The rating levels for the language content type are defined in Oracle Fusion Profile Management.

columns.Name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates if the qualification is mandatory for Search and Evaluate that will result in filtering out those resources who don't have this qualification.The 'Y' value of flag indicates that qualification is mandatory and 'N' or Null value indicates that it is optional.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_REQUEST_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier for a resource associated to a project resource request/

columns.Name: RESOURCE_REQUEST_ID
columns.Comments: Automatically-generated unique identifier for a resource associated to a project resource request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.Comments: Unique identifier of the resource who is selected to fulfill the project resource request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_STATUS
columns.Comments: Status of a resource for a  project resource request.

columns.Name: PM_REQUESTED_RESOURCE_ID
columns.Comments: PM_REQUESTED_RESOUCE_ID

columns.Name: RESOURCE_COST_RATE
columns.Comments: Cost rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_BILL_RATE
columns.Comments: Bill rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_COST_RATE_CURR_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency of the cost rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_BILL_RATE_CURR_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency of the bill rate for the resource who is selected on the request.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_REJECT_REASON_CODE
columns.Comments: Code for the reason a proposed resource is rejected for a project resource assignment.

columns.Name: STAFFING_OWNER_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the person who is creating the resource for the project resource request.

columns.Name: ASSIGN_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier for the Assignment.

columns.Name: CURRENT_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates whether the project resource request is the most recent request for the assignment.  A value of Y when the ASSIGN_ID column is blank indicates that the request is not fulfilled.  A value of Y when the ASSIGN_ID column contains a value indicates that the request is the most recently-approved adjustment request for the assignment.  A value of N indicates that there is a subsequent approved adjustment request for the assignment.

columns.Name: ORIG_ASSIGN_START_DATE
columns.Comments: Assigned start date for resource for a project resource request when the request is originally fulfilled.

columns.Name: ORIG_ASSIGN_FINISH_DATE
columns.Comments: Assigned finish date for resource for a project resource request when the request is originally fulfilled.

columns.Name: ORIG_ASSIGN_USE_CAL_FLAG
columns.Comments:
Indicates the option the resources assigned hours are based on when the request is originally fulfilled:
Y=Project calendar hours
N=Specified hours in HOURS_PER_DAY column
X=Variable hours in HOURS_PER_DAY1 - HOURS_PER_DAY7
W=Specified weekly hours in HOURS_PER_INTERVAL  column

columns.Name: ORIG_ASSIGN_HOURS_PER_DAY
columns.Comments: Original number of assignment hours per day on the project resource assignment, if different than the project calendar, when the request is originally fulfilled.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_PROPOSED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date a resource is proposed to fulfill a project resource request. The status of the project resource request changes from Open to Resource Proposed.

columns.Name: FULFILLED_DATE
columns.Comments: The date a resource is approved to fulfill a project resource request. If project manager approval is required, the fulfilled date is when the status of the request changes from Resource Proposed to Fulfilled. If approval is not required, the fulfilled date is when the status of the request changes from Open to Fulfilled.

columns.Name: TOTAL_HOURS
columns.Comments: The total number of hours that are requested on a project resource request. columns.Name: PROJECT_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the project.

columns.Name: PROJECT_DESCRIPTION
columns.Comments: Description of the project.

columns.Name: PROJECT_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Identifier of the project from the source application.

columns.Name: PROJECT_START_DATE
columns.Comments: Planned or actual start date of the project.

columns.Name: PROJECT_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.Comments: Planned or actual completion date of the project.

columns.Name: SCHEDULE_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the calendar used for planning the project.

columns.Name: PROJECT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.Comments: Currency code for all financial amounts recorded in the project plan. If not specified, it is defaulted to the default project currency code configured through application setup.

columns.Name: PROJECT_MANAGER_EMAIL_ID
columns.Comments: E-mail address of the project manager.

columns.Name: PROJECT_EXTERNAL_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the project from the source application.

columns.Name: PROJECT_STATUS
columns.Comments: Staus of the project.Valid values are Active,Draft,Closed.

columns.Name: EPS_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of Enterprise structure node associated to the project.

columns.Name: TASK_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Sequence in which tasks are created. For example, the sequence number of sub tasks must be greater than the sequence number of related summary tasks.

columns.Name: TASK_NUMBER
columns.Comments: Task number from the source application.

columns.Name: TASK_EXTERNAL_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the task from the source application.

columns.Name: PARENT_TASK_EXTERNAL_ID
columns.Comments: Identifier of the immediate summary task of this task from the source application.

columns.Name: TASK_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the task.

columns.Name: EFFORT
columns.Comments: Planned effort for the task.

columns.Name: EFFORT_UNIT
columns.Comments: Unit of measure for valid effort values are DAYS and HOURS.

columns.Name: START_DATE
columns.Comments: Planned start date of the task.

columns.Name: FINISH_DATE
columns.Comments: Planned finish date of the task.

columns.Name: ACTUAL_START_DATE
columns.Comments: Actual start date of the task.

columns.Name: ACTUAL_FINISH_DATE
columns.Comments: Actual finish date of the task.

columns.Name: ACTUAL_EFFORT
columns.Comments: Actual effort spent on the task.

columns.Name: REMAINING_EFFORT
columns.Comments: Effort remaining on the task.

columns.Name: DURATION
columns.Comments: Number of calendar days from the task start date to the task finish date.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY
columns.Comments: Number of hours in a working day.

columns.Name: MILESTONE_FLAG
columns.Comments: Indicates if the task is milestone.

columns.Name: PROGRESS_STATUS
columns.Comments: Progress status of the task. Valid values are NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, and COMPLETE.

columns.Name: HEALTH_STATUS
columns.Comments: Health status of the task. Valid values are ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, or IN_TROUBLE.

columns.Name: PERCENT_COMPLETE
columns.Comments: Percent of work complete on a task.

columns.Name: SPRINT
columns.Comments: Sprint in which the task is completed or expected to be complete. Valid values are configured during application setup.

columns.Name: PHYSICAL_PERCENT_COMPLETE
columns.Comments: Percentage of physical work completed.

columns.Name: PRIORITY
columns.Comments: Priority of the task.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.Comments: Type of the resource assigned to the task. Valid values are LABOR and EXPENSE.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_NAME
columns.Comments: Name of the expense resource assigned to the task. Required if the Resource Type is EXPENSE.

columns.Name: RESOURCE_EMAIL_ID
columns.Comments: E-mail ID of the labor resource assigned to the task. Required if the Resource Type is LABOR.

columns.Name: LABOR_RES_ALLOC_PERCENT
columns.Comments: Allocation percentage for the labor resource assigned to the task.

columns.Name: EXP_PLANNED_COST_AMOUNT
columns.Comments: Planned expense cost for the specific expense resource assigned to the task.

columns.Name: EXP_ACTUAL_COST_AMOUNT
columns.Comments: Actual expense cost for the specific expense resource assigned to the task.

columns.Name: EXP_REMAINING_COST_AMOUNT
columns.Comments: Remaining expense cost for the specific expense resource assigned to the task.

columns.Name: USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG
columns.Comments:
Indicates the option the resources assigned hour are based on: 
Y is Project calendar hours
N is Specified daily hours in HOURS_PER_DAY column
X is Variable hours in HOURS_PER_DAY1 - HOURS_PER_DAY7 columns.
W is Specified weekly hours in HOURS_PER_INTERVAL  column

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY
columns.Comments: The number of hours that a resource is assigned each working day during the assignment date range. HOURS_PER_DAY can be greater than the default value of 0 only if the USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG is value is N.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY1
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Sunday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY2
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Monday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY3
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Tuesday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY4
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Wednesday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY5
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Thursday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY6
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Friday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_DAY7
columns.Comments: Hours per day value for every Saturday when Variable Hours is selected, that is USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG = X.

columns.Name: HOURS_PER_INTERVAL
columns.Comments: Hours to be spread over the time interval specified in USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG . Currently, the column captures weekly hours when USE_PROJ_CALENDAR_HOUR_FLAG=W.

GMS_ACTIVE_FUNDING_PATTERN_V.query:

  DECODE("b"."determinant1", NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS "fp_exists"
FROM "pjc_distribute_patterns_b" "a"
LEFT JOIN "pjc_distribute_patterns_b" "b"
  ON "a"."determinant1" = "b"."determinant1"
  AND "b"."business_function_code" = 'AWD_DISTR'
  AND "b"."status" = 'ORA_GMS_FUND_PATTRN_STS_ACTIVE'
WHERE
  "a"."business_function_code" = 'AWD_DISTR'

GMS_ALL_CONTACTS_V.query:
SELECT
/*+ FIRST_ROWS(10) */
distinct AP.PERSONNEL_ID as PERS_ID,
PPN.DISPLAY_NAME as NAME ,
NULL as ORGANIZATION_ID,
NULL as ORGANIZATION_NAME,
PPH.PHONE_NUMBER as PHONE_NUMBER,
PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS as EMAIL_ADDRESS,
NULL as JOB_TITLE,
NULL as CONTACT_TYPE
FROM
gms_award_personnel AP,
PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PAP,
PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PPN,
PER_PHONES_V PPH,
PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES_V PEA
WHERE
AP.PERSONNEL_ID = PAP.PERSON_ID
AND
INTERNAL_FLAG = 'Y'
AND
PAP.PERSON_ID = PPN.PERSON_ID
AND
PAP.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = PEA.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID (+)
AND
PAP.PRIMARY_PHONE_ID = PPH.PHONE_ID (+)
AND
trunc(SYSDATE) between trunc(PAP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
AND
trunc
(PAP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
AND
trunc(SYSDATE) between trunc(PPN.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
AND
trunc
(PPN.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
UNION
all
SELECT
DISTINCT EC.PARTY_ID as PERS_ID,
EC.PARTY_NAME as RESOURCE_SOURCE,
EC.PARTY_ID as ORGANIZATION_ID,
NULL as ORGANIZATION_NAME,
EC.PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER as PHONE_NUMBER,
EC.EMAIL_ADDRESS as EMAIL_ADDRESS,
EC.JOB_TITLE as JOB_TITLE,
null as CONTACT_TYPE
FROM

WHERE
AP.PERSONNEL_ID = EC.PARTY_ID
AND
AP.INTERNAL_FLAG = 'N'

GMS_APRD_COST_PLAN_VERSIONS_V.query:
SELECT
PjoPlanVersionsVl.VERSION_NAME,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.VERSION_NUMBER,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PROJECT_ID,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLAN_VERSION_ID,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLAN_TYPE_ID,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLAN_STATUS_CODE,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLAN_CLASS_CODE,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLANNED_FOR_CODE,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.MULTI_ERROR_FLAG,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.OBJECT_ID1,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE,
PjoPlanningOptions.APPROVED_COST_PLAN_TYPE_FLAG,
PjoPlanningOptions.PLANNING_OPTION_ID,
PjoPlanningOptions.TIME_PHASED_CODE,
PjoPlanningOptions.PLAN_LEVEL_CODE,
PjoPlanVersionsVl.LOCKED_BY_PERSON_ID,
RBSHeader.NAME AS NAME1,
RBSHeader.RBS_HEADER_ID,
ParentRBSHeader.NAME AS NAME2,
ParentRBSHeader.RBS_HEADER_ID AS RBS_HEADER_ID1,
RBSHeader.CENTRALLY_CONTROL_FLAG,
RBSHeader.SOURCE_RBS_HEADER_ID,
case when (RBSHeader.CENTRALLY_CONTROL_FLAG = 'N'
AND
RBSHeader.SOURCE_RBS_HEADER_ID is not null) then ParentRBSHeader.NAME else RBSHeader.NAME end as Name
FROM
PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL PjoPlanVersionsVl, PJO_PLANNING_OPTIONS PjoPlanningOptions, PJF_RBS_VERSIONS_B ProjectResourceBreakdownStru1, PJF_RBS_HEADERS_VL RBSHeader, PJF_RBS_HEADERS_VL ParentRBSHeader
WHERE
PjoPlanVersionsVl.plan_version_id = PjoPlanningOptions.plan_version_id
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.plan_class_code = 'BUDGET'
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.structure_version_id is null
AND
(PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLANNED_FOR_CODE <> 'REVENUE' )
AND
(PjoPlanningOptions.APPROVED_COST_PLAN_TYPE_FLAG = 'Y' )
AND
(PjoPlanningOptions.TIME_PHASED_CODE = 'A' )
AND
PjoPlanningOptions.RBS_VERSION_ID = ProjectResourceBreakdownStru1.RBS_VERSION_ID
AND
ProjectResourceBreakdownStru1.RBS_HEADER_ID = RBSHeader.RBS_HEADER_ID
AND
RBSHeader.SOURCE_RBS_HEADER_ID = ParentRBSHeader.RBS_HEADER_ID(+)

GMS_AWARDS_PER_PI_USER_V.query:
SELECT
AwardPersonnelEO.AWARD_ID AS ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_PERSONNEL AwardPersonnelEO,
(SELECT
ProjectRoleTypePEO.PROJECT_ROLE_ID,
PerUserPEO.person_id
FROM
PJF_PROJ_ROLE_TYPES_b ProjectRoleTypePEO,
PER_USERS PerUserPEO,
per_user_roles PerUserRoles,
FND_SESSION_ROLE_SETS SROLE,
per_roles_dn_vl RolePEO
WHERE
PerUserPEO.person_id = hrc_session_util.get_user_personid
AND
PerUserRoles.user_id = PerUserPEO.user_id
AND
PerUserRoles.role_id = RolePEO.role_id
AND
SROLE.SESSION_ROLE_SET_KEY = FND_GLOBAL.SESSION_ROLE_SET_KEY
AND
SROLE.ROLE_NAME = RolePEO.ROLE_COMMON_NAME
AND
ProjectRoleTypePEO.ROLE_ID = RolePEO.role_id
AND
(TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(ProjectRoleTypePEO.START_DATE_ACTIVE)
AND
TRUNC(NVL(ProjectRoleTypePEO.End_DATE_ACTIVE,SYSDATE)))
AND
( ProjectRoleTypePEO.PROJECT_ROLE_ID = 3
OR
ProjectRoleTypePEO.ROLE_ID =
(SELECT
a.ROLE_ID PI_ROLE_ID
FROM
PJF_PROJ_ROLE_TYPES_B a
WHERE
a.PROJECT_ROLE_ID = 2
))
) PI_ROLE_USER
WHERE
AwardPersonnelEO.ROLE_ID = PI_ROLE_USER.PROJECT_ROLE_ID
AND
AwardPersonnelEO.personnel_id = PI_ROLE_USER.person_id
AND
(TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(AwardPersonnelEO.START_DATE)
AND
TRUNC(NVL(AwardPersonnelEO.END_DATE,SYSDATE)))

GMS_AWARD_ALL_FUND_TOTAL_V.query:
SELECT
  "fundings"."award_id" AS "award_id",
  SUM(
    NVL("fundings"."direct_funding_amount", 0) + NVL("fundings"."indirect_funding_amount", 0)
  ) AS "total_fund_amount",
  SUM(
    NVL("fundings"."lc_direct_funding_amount", 0) + NVL("fundings"."lc_indirect_funding_amount", 0)
  ) AS "total_lc_fund_amount"
FROM "gms_award_fundings_vl" "fundings"
GROUP BY
  "fundings"."award_id"
GMS_AWARD_ALL_FUND_TOTAL_V.query_databricks:
SELECT
  `fundings`.`award_id` AS `award_id`,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(`fundings`.`direct_funding_amount`, 0) + COALESCE(`fundings`.`indirect_funding_amount`, 0)
  ) AS `total_fund_amount`,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(`fundings`.`lc_direct_funding_amount`, 0) + COALESCE(`fundings`.`lc_indirect_funding_amount`, 0)
  ) AS `total_lc_fund_amount`
FROM `gms_award_fundings_vl` AS `fundings`
GROUP BY
  `fundings`.`award_id`

GMS_AWARD_BUDGETS_V.query:
SELECT
  "a"."project_id" AS "project_id",
  "a"."object_id1" AS "object_id1",
  "a"."plan_type_id" AS "plan_type_id",
  "a"."planned_for_code" AS "planned_for_code",
  "b"."time_phased_code" AS "time_phased_code",
  "a"."plan_status_code" AS "plan_status_code",
  "a"."plan_version_id" AS "plan_version_id",
  "a"."total_pc_raw_cost" AS "total_pc_raw_cost",
  "a"."total_pc_brdnd_cost" AS "total_pc_brdnd_cost",
  "a"."pfc_raw_cost" AS "pfc_raw_cost",
  "a"."pfc_brdnd_cost" AS "pfc_brdnd_cost"
FROM "pjo_plan_versions_b" "a"
JOIN "pjo_planning_options" "b"
  ON "a"."plan_version_id" = "b"."plan_version_id"
  AND "b"."approved_cost_plan_type_flag" = 'Y'
  AND "b"."plan_type_code" = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
WHERE
  "a"."current_plan_status_flag" = 'Y'
  AND "a"."object_type_code" = 'AWARD'
  AND "a"."plan_class_code" = 'BUDGET'
ORDER BY
  "a"."project_id"

  `a`.`project_id` AS `project_id`,
  `a`.`object_id1` AS `object_id1`,

  `b`.`time_phased_code` AS `time_phased_code`,

  `a`.`pfc_raw_cost` AS `pfc_raw_cost`,
  `a`.`pfc_brdnd_cost` AS `pfc_brdnd_cost`
FROM `pjo_plan_versions_b` AS `a`
JOIN `pjo_planning_options` AS `b`
  ON `a`.`plan_version_id` = `b`.`plan_version_id`
  AND `b`.`approved_cost_plan_type_flag` = 'Y'

  `a`.`current_plan_status_flag` = 'Y'

  `a`.`project_id` NULLS LAST

GMS_AWARD_CREDIT_ORG_ALL_V.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  "haof"."organization_id" AS "organization_id",
  "haotl"."name" AS "name",
  "haof"."effective_start_date" AS "effective_start_date",
  "haof"."effective_end_date" AS "effective_end_date"
FROM "hr_all_organization_units_f" "haof"
JOIN "hr_organization_units_f_tl" "haotl"
  ON "haof"."effective_end_date" = "haotl"."effective_end_date"
  AND "haof"."effective_start_date" = "haotl"."effective_start_date"
  AND "haof"."organization_id" = "haotl"."organization_id"
  AND "haotl"."language" = USERENV('LANG')
JOIN "hr_org_unit_classifications_f" "ouc"
  ON "haof"."organization_id" = "ouc"."organization_id"
  AND "ouc"."classification_code" IN ('PA_PROJECT_ORG', 'DEPARTMENT')
  AND TRUNC("haof"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC("ouc"."effective_end_date", 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("haof"."effective_start_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC("ouc"."effective_start_date", 'DD')
WHERE
  TRUNC("haof"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("haof"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
GMS_AWARD_CREDIT_ORG_ALL_V.query_databricks:
SELECT DISTINCT
  `haof`.`organization_id` AS `organization_id`,
  `haotl`.`name` AS `name`,
  `haof`.`effective_start_date` AS `effective_start_date`,
  `haof`.`effective_end_date` AS `effective_end_date`
FROM `hr_all_organization_units_f` AS `haof`
JOIN `hr_organization_units_f_tl` AS `haotl`
  ON `haof`.`effective_end_date` = `haotl`.`effective_end_date`
  AND `haof`.`effective_start_date` = `haotl`.`effective_start_date`
  AND `haof`.`organization_id` = `haotl`.`organization_id`
  AND `haotl`.`language` = USERENV('LANG')
JOIN `hr_org_unit_classifications_f` AS `ouc`
  ON `haof`.`organization_id` = `ouc`.`organization_id`
  AND `ouc`.`classification_code` IN ('PA_PROJECT_ORG', 'DEPARTMENT')
  AND TRUNC(`haof`.`effective_start_date`, 'DD') <= TRUNC(`ouc`.`effective_end_date`, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC(`haof`.`effective_start_date`, 'DD') >= TRUNC(`ouc`.`effective_start_date`, 'DD')
WHERE

GMS_AWARD_FUNDING_BY_PERIOD_V.query:
SELECT
T.AWARD_ID,
T.id as BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
T.START_DATE,
T.END_DATE,
F.PTD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT as PTD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT,
SUM(F.PTD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT) over (partition by F.AWARD_ID
ORDER BY
T.START_DATE rows unbounded preceding) as ITD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT,
F.PTD_FUND_AMOUNT as PTD_FUND_AMOUNT,
SUM(F.PTD_FUND_AMOUNT) over (partition by F.AWARD_ID
ORDER BY
T.START_DATE rows unbounded preceding) as ITD_FUND_AMOUNT,
G.PTD_LC_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT as PTD_LC_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT,
SUM(G.PTD_LC_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT) over (partition by G.AWARD_ID
ORDER BY
T.START_DATE rows unbounded preceding) as ITD_LC_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT,
G.PTD_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT as PTD_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT,
SUM(G.PTD_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT) over (partition by G.AWARD_ID
ORDER BY
T.START_DATE rows unbounded preceding) as ITD_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT
from
(SELECT
a.AWARD_ID,
SUM(a.LC_DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT + a.LC_INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT) PTD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT,
SUM(a.DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT + a.INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT) PTD_FUND_AMOUNT,
a.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID
FROM
(SELECT
A.ID AS BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
A.AWARD_ID,
A.BUDGET_PERIOD,
A.START_DATE,
A.END_DATE,
NVL(B.LC_DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS LC_DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.LC_INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS LC_INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.ID, 0) AS FUNDING_ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_BUDGET_PERIODS A,
GMS_AWARD_FUNDINGS_B B
WHERE
A.ID = B.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID(+)) a
GROUP BY
a.AWARD_ID,
a.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID
) F,
(SELECT
B2.AWARD_ID,
SUM(A2.LC_FUNDING_AMOUNT) PTD_LC_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT,
SUM(A2.FUNDING_AMOUNT) PTD_FUND_ALLOCATE_AMOUNT,
B2.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
B2.START_DATE,
B2.END_DATE
FROM
GMS_AWARD_FUND_ALLOCATIONS A2,
(SELECT
A.ID AS BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
A.AWARD_ID,
A.BUDGET_PERIOD,
A.START_DATE,
A.END_DATE,
NVL(B.LC_DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS LC_DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.LC_INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS LC_INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS INDIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
NVL(B.ID, 0) AS FUNDING_ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_BUDGET_PERIODS A,
GMS_AWARD_FUNDINGS_B B
WHERE
A.ID = B.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID(+)) B2
WHERE
A2.FUNDING_ID(+) = B2.FUNDING_ID
GROUP BY
B2.AWARD_ID,
B2.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
B2.START_DATE,
B2.END_DATE
) G,
GMS_AWARD_BUDGET_PERIODS T
WHERE
F.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID = T.id
AND
G.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID = T.id
ORDER BY
T.AWARD_ID,
T.START_DATE

SELECT

PI.START_DATE,
PI.END_DATE,
PERSONNAMEDPEO.PERSON_ID,
PERSONNAMEDPEO.DISPLAY_NAME PI_NAME,
PERSONPEO.PERSON_ID P_PERSON_ID
from
(SELECT
a.id, a.AWARD_ID, a.START_DATE, a.END_DATE, a.PERSONNEL_ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_PERSONNEL a,
(SELECT
AWD_PER.id as id,
ACT_PER.START_DATE as ACT_START_DATE,
FUT_PER.START_DATE as FUT_START_DATE,
PAS_PER.START_DATE as PAS_START_DATE,
NVL(ACT_PER.START_DATE, (NVL(FUT_PER.START_DATE, NVL(PAS_PER.START_DATE, sysdate))))as FINAL_DATE
FROM
GMS_AWARD_HEADERS_B AWD_PER,
(SELECT
START_DATE,
AWARD_ID as AWARD_ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_PERSONNEL
WHERE
ROLE_ID = 2
AND
AWD_PROJECT_LNK_ID is null
AND
TRUNC(sysdate) between TRUNC(START_DATE)
AND
TRUNC(NVL(END_DATE, sysdate))
) ACT_PER,
(SELECT
min(START_DATE) as START_DATE,
AWARD_ID as AWARD_ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_PERSONNEL
WHERE
ROLE_ID = 2
AND
AWD_PROJECT_LNK_ID is null
AND
START_DATE > sysdate
GROUP BY
AWARD_ID
) FUT_PER,
(SELECT
max(START_DATE) as START_DATE,
AWARD_ID as AWARD_ID
FROM
GMS_AWARD_PERSONNEL
WHERE
ROLE_ID = 2
AND
AWD_PROJECT_LNK_ID is null
AND
END_DATE < sysdate
GROUP BY
AWARD_ID
) PAS_PER
WHERE
AWD_PER.id = ACT_PER.AWARD_ID(+)
AND
AWD_PER.id = FUT_PER.AWARD_ID(+)
AND
AWD_PER.id = PAS_PER.AWARD_ID(+))PI_IN
WHERE
a.AWARD_ID = PI_IN.id
AND
a.START_DATE = PI_IN.FINAL_DATE
AND
a.ROLE_ID = 2
AND
a.AWD_PROJECT_LNK_ID is null
)PI,
PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PERSONNAMEDPEO,
PER_PERSONS PERSONPEO
WHERE
PI.PERSONNEL_ID = PERSONPEO.PERSON_ID
AND
PERSONNAMEDPEO.PERSON_ID = PERSONPEO.PERSON_ID
AND
TRUNC(GREATEST(sysdate, PERSONPEO.START_DATE)) between TRUNC(PERSONNAMEDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)

TRUNC(PERSONNAMEDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)

GMS_AWARD_PROJECT_FUNDINGS_V.query:
SELECT
T.AWARD_ID,
T.ID AS BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
T.START_DATE,
T.END_DATE,
G.PROJECT_ID,
NVL(G.PTD_LC_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS PTD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT,
SUM(NVL(G.PTD_LC_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY G.AWARD_ID, G.PROJECT_ID
ORDER BY
T.START_DATE ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS ITD_LC_FUND_AMOUNT,
NVL(G.PTD_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0) AS PTD_FUND_AMOUNT,
SUM(NVL(G.PTD_FUNDING_AMOUNT, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY G.AWARD_ID, G.PROJECT_ID
ORDER BY
T.START_DATE ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS ITD_FUND_AMOUNT
FROM
(SELECT
B2.AWARD_ID, B2.PROJECT_ID,
B2.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID,
B2.START_DATE,
B2.END_DATE,
SUM(A2.LC_FUNDING_AMOUNT) AS PTD_LC_FUNDING_AMOUNT,
SUM(A2.FUNDING_AMOUNT) AS PTD_FUNDING_AMOUNT
FROM
GMS_PROJECT_PERIOD_FUNDINGS_V A2,
GMS_PROJECT_BUDGET_PERIODS_V B2
WHERE
A2.LINKAGE_ID(+) = B2.LINKAGE_ID
AND
A2.AWARD_ID(+) = B2.AWARD_ID
AND
A2.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID(+) = B2.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID
GROUP BY
B2.AWARD_ID, B2.PROJECT_ID, B2.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID, B2.START_DATE, B2.END_DATE) G,
GMS_AWARD_BUDGET_PERIODS T
WHERE
G.BUDGET_PERIOD_ID = T.ID
AND
G.AWARD_ID = T.AWARD_ID
ORDER BY
T.AWARD_ID, G.PROJECT_ID, T.START_DATE

GMS_CURRENT_WRK_BUDGET_FDTL_V.query:
SELECT
h.project_id,
h.award_id,
h.plan_version_id,
h.budget_period_id,
h.start_date,
h.task_id,
h.planning_element_id,
h.rbs_element_id,
h.funding_source_id,
nvl(h.total_budget, 0) as total_budget,
SUM(nvl(h.total_budget, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY h.plan_version_id, h.task_id, h.planning_element_id, h.rbs_element_id
ORDER BY
h.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS itd_total_budget,
nvl(h.pc_total_budget, 0) as pc_total_budget,
SUM( nvl(h.pc_total_budget, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY h.plan_version_id, h.task_id, h.planning_element_id, h.rbs_element_id
ORDER BY
h.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS pc_itd_total_budget
FROM
(SELECT
e.project_id,
e.plan_version_id,
e.award_id,
e.budget_period_id,
e.start_date,
e.task_id,
e.planning_element_id,
e.rbs_element_id,
e.funding_source_id,
g.total_budget,
g.pc_total_budget
FROM
(SELECT
i.object_id1 AS AWARD_ID,
a.project_id,
a.task_id,
a.plan_version_id,
a.planning_element_id,
a.rbs_element_id,
a.FUNDING_SOURCE_ID,
d.id AS budget_period_id,
d.start_date
FROM
pjo_planning_elements a,
pjo_plan_versions_b i,
gms_award_budget_periods d
WHERE
a.plan_version_id = i.plan_version_id
AND
i.object_id1 = d.award_id
)e,
(SELECT
a.plan_version_id,
a.project_id,
a.task_id,
a.planning_element_id,
a.rbs_element_id,
a.FUNDING_SOURCE_ID,
b.AWARD_PERIOD_ID,
NVL(SUM(b.PFC_BRDND_COST), 0) AS total_budget,
NVL(SUM(b.PC_BRDND_COST), 0) AS pc_total_budget
FROM
pjo_planning_elements a,
pjo_plan_line_details b
WHERE
a.planning_element_id = b.planning_element_id
AND
a.plan_version_id = b.plan_version_id
GROUP BY
a.plan_version_id,
a.project_id,
a.task_id,
a.planning_element_id,
a.rbs_element_id,
a.FUNDING_SOURCE_ID,
b.AWARD_PERIOD_ID
) g
WHERE
e.plan_version_id = g.plan_version_id(+)
AND
e.budget_period_id = g.award_period_id(+)
AND
e.project_id = g.project_id(+)
AND
e.task_id = g.task_id(+)
AND
e.planning_element_id = g.planning_element_id(+)
AND
e.rbs_element_id = g.rbs_element_id(+)
AND
e.funding_source_id = g.funding_source_id(+)
) h
ORDER BY
h.award_id,
h.project_id,
h.task_id,
h.planning_element_id,
h.rbs_element_id,
h.start_date
