PeriodPEO.id as award_period_id,
periodpeo.budget_period,
periodpeo.start_date,
periodpeo.end_date,
AwardProjectPEO.project_id,
PjoPlanningOptions.plan_version_id,
task_structure.element_id,
task_structure.olap_self_node_flag,
projectpeo.project_id as projectpeo_id,
ProjectPEO.name as project_name,
task_info.proj_element_id,
task_info.project_id as task_project_id,
task_info.name as task_name,
task_structure.parent_element_id,
parent_info.proj_element_id as parent_proj_element_id,
parent_info.project_id as parenet_project_id,
nvl(parent_info.name, task_info.name) as parent_task_name,
task_version_info.element_version_id,
task_version_info.display_sequence,
parent_version_info.element_version_id as parent_element_version_id,
parent_version_info.display_sequence as parent_disaply_sequence
FROM
gms_award_projects AwardProjectPEO,
gms_award_budget_periods PeriodPEO,
pjs_fbs_d task_structure,
pjf_proj_elements_vl task_info,
PJF_PROJ_ELEMENT_VERSION task_version_info,
pjf_proj_elements_vl parent_info,
PJF_PROJ_ELEMENT_VERSION parent_version_info,
PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_VL PjoPlanVersionsVl,
PJO_PLANNING_OPTIONS PjoPlanningOptions,
PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL ProjectPEO
WHERE
AwardProjectPEO.award_id = PeriodPEO.award_id
AND
AwardProjectPEO.project_id = task_structure.project_id
AND
task_structure.leaf_node_flag = 'Y'
AND
task_structure.element_id = task_info.proj_element_id
AND
task_structure.parent_element_id = parent_info.proj_element_id(+)
AND
task_structure.element_id = task_version_info.proj_element_id
AND
task_structure.project_id = task_version_info.project_id
AND
task_structure.parent_element_id = parent_version_info.proj_element_id(+)
AND
task_structure.project_id = parent_version_info.project_id(+)
AND
AwardProjectPEO.project_id = ProjectPEO.project_id
AND
AwardProjectPEO.PROJECT_ID = PjoPlanVersionsVl.PROJECT_ID
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLAN_VERSION_ID = PjoPlanningOptions.PLAN_VERSION_ID
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
AND
PjoPlanningOptions.plan_type_code = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN'
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.plan_class_code = 'BUDGET'
AND
PjoPlanVersionsVl.plan_version_id = PjoPlanningOptions.plan_version_id
AND
PjoPlanningOptions.approved_cost_plan_type_flag = 'Y'
AND
PjoPlanningOptions.APPROVED_REV_PLAN_TYPE_FLAG = 'Y'
ORDER BY
ProjectPEO.name, parent_version_info.display_sequence, task_version_info.display_sequence,
periodpeo.start_date

GMS_XCC_BUDGET_BALANCE_V.query:
SELECT
ARG.budget_period_id,
ARG.start_date,
ARG.award_id,
ARG.project_id,
ARG.funding_source_id,
ARG.BUDGET_PERIOD,
ARG.segment_value1,
ARG.segment_value2,
ARG.segment_value3,
ARG.top_resource,
ARG.segment_value4,
ARG.segment_value5,
ARG.segment_value6,
ARG.segment_value7,
ARG.budget_amount as ptd_budget_amount,
sum(ARG.budget_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS itd_total_budget,
ARG.funds_available_amount as ptd_funds_available_amount,
sum(ARG.funds_available_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_funds_available_amount,
ARG.consumed_amount as ptd_consumed_amount,
sum(ARG.consumed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_consumed_amount,
ARG.Requisition_Consumed_AMT as ptd_Requ_Consumed_AMT,
sum(ARG.Requisition_Consumed_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_Requ_Consumed_AMT,
ARG.Purchase_order_Consumed_AMT as ptd_Pur_order_Consumed_AMT,
sum(ARG.Purchase_order_Consumed_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_Pur_order_Consumed_AMT,
ARG.Invoice_Consumed_AMT as ptd_Inv_Consumed_AMT,
sum(ARG.Invoice_Consumed_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_Inv_Consumed_AMT,
ARG.Project_Exp_Consumed_AMT as ptd_Proj_Exp_Consumed_AMT,
sum(ARG.Project_Exp_Consumed_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_Proj_Exp_Consumed_AMT,
ARG.Receipts_Consumed_AMT as ptd_Receipts_Consumed_AMT,
sum(ARG.Receipts_Consumed_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3, ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_Receipts_Consumed_AMT,
ARG.SPEND_AUTHORIZE_CONSUMED_AMT as ptd_SPEND_AUTH_CONSUMED_AMT,
sum(ARG.SPEND_AUTHORIZE_CONSUMED_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY ARG.award_id, ARG.project_id, ARG.segment_value3,ARG.segment_value4, ARG.segment_value5, ARG.segment_value6, ARG.segment_value7
ORDER BY
ARG.start_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as itd_SPEND_AUTH_CONSUMED_AMT
FROM
(
SELECT
byBP.budget_period_id,
byBP.start_date,
byBP.award_id,
byBP.project_id,
byBP.xcc_project_id,
fs.funding_source_id,
byBP.BUDGET_PERIOD,
byBP.segment_value1,
byBP.segment_value2,
byBP.segment_value3,
byBP.segment_value4,
byBP.segment_value5,
byBP.segment_value6,
byBP.segment_value7,
substr(decode(byBP.segment_value7, NULL, byBP.segment_value3, byBP.segment_value5), INSTRB(decode(byBP.segment_value7, NULL, byBP.segment_value3, byBP.segment_value5),':',1)+1) top_resource,
nvl(bybal.budget_amount, 0) budget_amount,
NVL(bybal.funds_available_amount,0) funds_available_amount,
NVL(bybal.consumed_amount, 0) consumed_amount,
NVL(bybal.Requisition_Consumed_AMT,0) Requisition_Consumed_AMT,
NVL(bybal.Purchase_order_Consumed_AMT,0) Purchase_order_Consumed_AMT,
NVL(bybal.Invoice_Consumed_AMT,0) Invoice_Consumed_AMT,
NVL(bybal.Project_Exp_Consumed_AMT,0) Project_Exp_Consumed_AMT,
NVL(bybal.Receipts_Consumed_AMT,0) Receipts_Consumed_AMT,
NVL(bybal.SPEND_AUTHORIZE_CONSUMED_AMT,0) SPEND_AUTHORIZE_CONSUMED_AMT
FROM
(SELECT
a.budget_period_id,
a.start_date,
a.award_id,
a.project_id,
b.project_id as xcc_project_Id,
a.budget_period,
b.segment_value1,
b.segment_value2,
b.segment_value3,
b.segment_value4,
b.segment_value5,
b.segment_value6,
b.segment_value7
FROM
GMS_PROJECT_BUDGET_PERIODS_V a,
(SELECT
DISTINCT di.segment_value1, di.segment_value2, di.segment_value3, di.segment_value4, di.segment_value5, di.segment_value6, di.segment_value7, di.project_id, di.contract_id, di.internal_budget_type_code
FROM
XCC_pjo_cb_balances_v di
WHERE
di.internal_budget_type_code IN ('A_P_TR_FS_TRACK', 'P_TT_LT_TR_LR_FS_TRK_SUM', 'P_TT_LT_TR_LR_FS_TRK_PRD') ) b
WHERE
a.award_id = b.contract_id(+)
AND
a.project_id = b.project_id(+)
) byBP,
XCC_pjo_cb_balances_v bybal,
GMS_FUNDING_SOURCES_B fs
WHERE
byBP.segment_value1 = bybal.segment_value1(+)
AND
byBP.segment_value2 = bybal.segment_value2(+)
AND
byBP.segment_value3 = bybal.segment_value3(+)
AND
byBP.segment_value4 = bybal.segment_value4(+)
AND
nvl(byBP.segment_value5, 1) = nvl(bybal.segment_value5(+), 1)
AND
nvl(byBP.segment_value6, 1) = nvl(bybal.segment_value6(+), 1)
AND
nvl(byBP.segment_value7, 1) = nvl(bybal.segment_value7(+), 1)
AND
byBP.BUDGET_PERIOD = bybal.PERIOD_NAME(+)
AND
byBP.award_id = bybal.contract_id(+)
AND
byBP.project_id = bybal.project_id(+)
AND
bybal.internal_budget_type_code(+) IN ('A_P_TR_FS_TRACK', 'P_TT_LT_TR_LR_FS_TRK_SUM', 'P_TT_LT_TR_LR_FS_TRK_PRD')
AND
decode(byBP.segment_value7, NULL, byBP.segment_value4, byBP.segment_value7) = fs.funding_source_number
ORDER BY
byBP.start_date) ARG
ORDER BY
ARG.segment_value1,
ARG.segment_value2,
ARG.segment_value3,
ARG.segment_value4,
ARG.segment_value5,
ARG.segment_value6,
ARG.segment_value7,
ARG.start_date

PJC_EXP_TYPES_CCW_V.query:
SELECT
  "et"."expenditure_type_id" AS "expenditure_type_id",
  "et"."expenditure_type_id" || '-' || "es"."system_linkage_function" AS "slf_expenditure_type_key",
  "et"."expenditure_type_name" AS "expenditure_type_name",
  "et"."expenditure_type_name" || ' - ' || "sl"."meaning" AS "sl_expenditure_type_name",
  "sl"."meaning" AS "system_linkage_m",
  "et"."description" AS "description",
  "es"."system_linkage_function" AS "system_linkage_function",
  "es"."start_date_active" AS "sys_link_start_date_active",
  "es"."end_date_active" AS "sys_link_end_date_active",
  "et"."start_date_active" AS "expnd_typ_start_date_active",
  "et"."end_date_active" AS "expnd_typ_end_date_active",
  "fsa"."determinant_value" AS "project_unit_id"
FROM "pjf_exp_types_vl" "et"
JOIN "pjf_expend_typ_sys_links" "es"
  ON "es"."expenditure_type_id" = "et"."expenditure_type_id"
JOIN "pjf_exp_types_b_st" "pts"
  ON "et"."expenditure_type_id" = "pts"."expenditure_type_id"
JOIN "fnd_setid_assignments" "fsa"
  ON "fsa"."determinant_type" = 'PU'
  AND "fsa"."reference_group_name" = 'PJF_TRANSACTION_TYPES'
  AND "fsa"."set_id" = "pts"."set_id"
JOIN "pjf_system_linkages_vl" "sl"
  ON "es"."system_linkage_function" = "sl"."function"

  `et`.`expenditure_type_name` AS `expenditure_type_name`,

  `fsa`.`determinant_value` AS `project_unit_id`
FROM `pjf_exp_types_vl` AS `et`

PersonDPEO.PERSON_NUMBER AS PERSON_NUMBER,

ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ELEMENT_TYPE_ID AS PAY_ELEMENT_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ORIG_TRANSACTION_REFERENCE AS ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.RUN_STATUS AS RUN_STATUS_CODE,
RunStatusLookup.MEANING AS RUN_STATUS,
TcRunStatus.RUN_STATUS_SUMMARY_CODE,
TcRunStatus.RUN_STATUS_SUMMARY,
nvl(documentPEO.document_code, 'LABOR_DIST') as document_code,
nvl(ProjectAllocTxnPEO.document_id, labor_dist_doc.document_id) as document_id,
nvl(documentPEO.transaction_source_id,labor_dist_doc.transaction_source_id) as transaction_source_id,
DECODE(documentPEO.document_code, null,'PROJECTS',documentPEO.transaction_source) as transaction_source,
nvl(documentPEO.user_transaction_source, labor_dist_doc.user_transaction_source) as user_transaction_source,
decode(ProjectAllocTxnPEO.net_zero_adjustment_flag, null, 'N', 'Y') as net_zero_adjustment_flag,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.payroll_name as PAYROLL_NAME,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.payroll_id as PAYROLL_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.cost_id as COST_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.COST_ALLOCATION_KEYFLEX_ID as COST_ALLOCATION_KEYFLEX_ID,
TcRunStatus.STATUS_REASON_CODE,
TcRunStatus.STATUS_REASON,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.TIMECARD_DIST_BASIS AS TIME_CARD_DISTRIBUTION_BASIS,
TCDistBasisLookup.meaning AS TIME_CARD_DIST_BASIS_NAME,
AssignmentDPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ASSIGN_DEPT_ID,
DeptPEO.NAME AS ASSIGN_DEPT_NAME,
OrgPEO.NAME AS BU_NAME
FROM
PJC_ALLOC_RUNS_ALL ProjectAllocTxnPEO,
PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F PersonDPEO,
PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V PersonNameDPEO,
PER_EMAIL_ADDRESSES EmailAddressPEO,
PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_F AssignmentDPEO,
HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL DeptPEO,
HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F_TL OrgPEO,
FND_LOOKUPS RunStatusLookup,
(SELECT
RunStatusReasonLookup.meaning AS STATUS_REASON,
RunStatusReasonLookup.lookup_code AS STATUS_REASON_CODE,
RunStatusSummaryLookup.LOOKUP_CODE AS RUN_STATUS_SUMMARY_CODE,
RunStatusSummaryLookup.meaning AS RUN_STATUS_SUMMARY
from
FND_LOOKUPS RunStatusSummaryLookup,
FND_LOOKUPS RunStatusReasonLookup
WHERE
RunStatusReasonLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ORA_PJC_LD_DIST_STATUS_REASON'
AND
RunStatusSummaryLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ORA_PJC_LD_COST_RUN_STATUS'
AND
RunStatusSummaryLookup.LOOKUP_CODE = (CASE WHEN RunStatusReasonLookup.lookup_code = 'ORA_SUCCESS' then 'LD_RUN_STATUS_SUCCESS'
WHEN RunStatusReasonLookup.lookup_code = 'ORA_ON_HOLD' THEN 'LD_RUN_STATUS_PENDING'
WHEN RunStatusReasonLookup.lookup_code = 'ORA_PARTIAL_ON_HOLD' THEN 'LD_RUN_STATUS_PARTIAL_SUCCESS'
WHEN RunStatusReasonLookup.lookup_code = 'ORA_NEEDS_REPROCESS' THEN 'LD_RUN_STATUS_NEED_REPROCESS'
WHEN RunStatusReasonLookup.lookup_code = 'ORA_IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'LD_RUN_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS'
ELSE 'LD_RUN_STATUS_ERROR' END)) TcRunStatus,
FND_LOOKUPS TCDistBasisLookup,
(SELECT
a.document_id, a.document_code, a.transaction_source_id, b.transaction_source, b.user_transaction_source
FROM
pjf_txn_document_b a, pjf_txn_sources_VL b
WHERE
a.transaction_source_id = b.transaction_source_id
AND
b.transaction_source in ('PROJECTS', 'OPAY')
AND
document_code in ('LABOR_DIST', 'PAYROLL_COSTS')) documentPEO,
(SELECT
a.document_id, a.document_code, a.transaction_source_id, b.transaction_source, b.user_transaction_source
FROM
pjf_txn_document_b a, pjf_txn_sources_VL b
WHERE
a.transaction_source_id = b.transaction_source_id
AND
b.transaction_source = 'PROJECTS'
AND
document_code = 'LABOR_DIST'
AND
rownum = 1) labor_dist_doc
WHERE
(ProjectAllocTxnPEO.RUN_STATUS = 'RS'
OR
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.RUN_STATUS = 'RF')
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERSON_ID = PersonDPEO.PERSON_ID
AND
GREATEST(SYSDATE, ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERIOD_START_DATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
AND
TRUNC(PersonDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERSON_ID = PersonNameDPEO.PERSON_ID
AND
GREATEST(SYSDATE, ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERIOD_START_DATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(PersonNameDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
AND
TRUNC(PersonNameDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERSON_ID = EmailAddressPEO.PERSON_ID(+)
AND
PersonDPEO.PRIMARY_EMAIL_ID = EmailAddressPEO.EMAIL_ADDRESS_ID(+)
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ASSIGNMENT_ID = AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_ID
AND
GREATEST(SYSDATE, ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERIOD_START_DATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE)
AND
TRUNC(AssignmentDPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.RUN_STATUS = RunStatusLookup.LOOKUP_CODE
AND
RunStatusLookup.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PJC_ALLOC_RUN_STATUS'
AND
nvl(ProjectAllocTxnPEO.TIMECARD_RUN_STATUS, DECODE(ProjectAllocTxnPEO.RUN_STATUS, 'RS', 'ORA_SUCCESS', 'ORA_FAILED')) = TcRunStatus.STATUS_REASON_CODE
AND
TCDistBasisLookup.lookup_type(+) = 'ORA_PJC_TIMECARD_DIST_BASIS'
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.TIMECARD_DIST_BASIS = TCDistBasisLookup.lookup_code(+)
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.document_id = documentPEO.document_id(+)
AND
AssignmentDPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID = DeptPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
AND
trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(DeptPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+))
AND
TRUNC(DeptPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
And DeptPEO.language(+) = userenv('LANG')
AND
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.ORG_ID = OrgPEO.ORGANIZATION_ID(+)
AND
trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(OrgPEO.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE(+))
AND
TRUNC(OrgPEO.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE(+))
AND
OrgPEO.language(+) = userenv('LANG')
GROUP BY
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.ORG_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_INTERFACE_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERIOD_START_DATE,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERIOD_END_DATE,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_BATCH_NAME,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_PERSON_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ELEMENT_TYPE,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ELEMENT_TYPE_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ASSIGNMENT_ID,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.LD_ORIG_TRANSACTION_REFERENCE,
PersonNameDPEO.DISPLAY_NAME,
PersonNameDPEO.FIRST_NAME,
PersonNameDPEO.LAST_NAME,
PersonDPEO.PERSON_NUMBER,
EmailAddressPEO.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_NAME,
AssignmentDPEO.ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.DENOM_CURRENCY_CODE,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.RUN_STATUS,
RunStatusLookup.MEANING,
nvl(documentPEO.document_code, 'LABOR_DIST'),
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.payroll_name,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.payroll_id,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.cost_id,
ProjectAllocTxnPEO.COST_ALLOCATION_KEYFLEX_ID,
nvl(ProjectAllocTxnPEO.document_id, labor_dist_doc.document_id) ,
nvl(documentPEO.transaction_source_id,labor_dist_doc.transaction_source_id),
DECODE(documentPEO.document_code,null,'PROJECTS',documentPEO.transaction_source),

TcRunStatus.STATUS_REASON,

ProjectAllocTxnPEO.TIMECARD_DIST_BASIS,

tcdist.created_by,
tcdist.creation_date,
tcdist.last_updated_by,
tcdist.last_update_date
FROM

(SELECT

out_tc.alloc_txn_id,
out_tc.group_status,
out_tc.distribution_status,
out_tc.created_by,
out_tc.creation_date,
out_tc.last_updated_by,
out_tc.last_update_date
FROM
pjc_payroll_tc_distributions out_tc
WHERE
((out_tc.group_status = 'ORA_DRAFT')
OR
(( out_tc.group_status <> 'ORA_DRAFT')
AND
(out_tc.new_payroll_dist_group_id is null)
AND
NOT EXISTS (
SELECT
1
FROM
pjc_payroll_tc_distributions in_tc
WHERE
out_tc.alloc_txn_id = in_tc.alloc_txn_id
AND
in_tc.group_status = 'ORA_DRAFT'
)))) tcdist,
fnd_messages msg
WHERE
run.run_id = txn.run_id
AND
txn.timecard_dist_flag = 'Y'
AND
txn.alloc_txn_id = tcdist.alloc_txn_id (+)
AND
msg.application_id(+) = 10036
AND
(
CASE
WHEN run.timecard_run_status = 'ORA_FAILED' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_NOT_EXECUTED'
WHEN run.timecard_run_status = 'ORA_ON_HOLD' THEN
'PJC_LD_OTHER_TC_DIST_IN_PROG'
WHEN run.timecard_run_status = 'ORA_PARTIAL_ON_HOLD' THEN
'PJC_LD_OTHER_TC_DIST_IN_PROG'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_DRAFT' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_RUNNING'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_PENDING' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_RUNNING'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_IN_PROGRESS' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_RUNNING'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_PARTIAL_SUCCESS' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_TARGET_ERRORS'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_REJECT_PENDING_TXN' THEN
'PJC_LD_UPC_OR_ADJ_PENDING'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_REJECT_NO_EI' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_NO_TARGETS'
WHEN tcdist.distribution_status = 'ORA_REJECT_GROUP_FAIL' THEN
'PJC_LD_TC_DIST_GROUP_FAIL'
ELSE
null
END
) = msg.message_name(+)

  ON "persondpeo"."effective_end_date" >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "persondpeo"."effective_start_date" <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "persondpeo"."person_id" = "personpeo"."person_id"
JOIN "per_person_names_f_v" "personnamedpeo"
  ON "personnamedpeo"."effective_end_date" >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "personnamedpeo"."effective_start_date" <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "personnamedpeo"."person_id" = "personpeo"."person_id"
JOIN "per_all_assignments_m" "assignmentdpeo"
  ON "assignmentdpeo"."effective_end_date" >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "assignmentdpeo"."effective_latest_change" = 'Y'
  AND "assignmentdpeo"."effective_start_date" <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "assignmentdpeo"."person_id" = "personpeo"."person_id"
  AND NOT "assignmentdpeo"."work_terms_assignment_id" IS NULL
LEFT JOIN "_u_0" "_u_0"
  ON "_u_0"."_u_1" = "assignmentdpeo"."assignment_id"
WHERE
  NOT "_u_0"."_u_1" IS NULL
ORDER BY
  "personnamedpeo"."display_name"
PJC_PERSON_ASSIGNMENTS_V.query_databricks:
WITH `_u_0` AS (
  SELECT
    `a`.`ld_assignment_id` AS `_u_1`
  FROM `pjc_alloc_runs_all` AS `a`
  GROUP BY
    `a`.`ld_assignment_id`
)
SELECT
  `assignmentdpeo`.`assignment_id` AS `assignment_id`,
  `personpeo`.`person_id` AS `person_id`,
  `persondpeo`.`person_number` AS `person_number`,
  `personnamedpeo`.`display_name` AS `display_name`,
  `personnamedpeo`.`list_name` AS `list_name`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`effective_start_date` AS `ass_effective_start_date`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`effective_end_date` AS `ass_effective_end_date`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`assignment_number` AS `assignment_number`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`assignment_name` AS `assignment_name`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`assignment_type` AS `assignment_type`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`assignment_status_type` AS `assignment_status_type`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`primary_flag` AS `primary_flag`,
  `assignmentdpeo`.`business_unit_id` AS `bu_id`
FROM `per_persons` AS `personpeo`
JOIN `per_all_people_f` AS `persondpeo`
  ON `persondpeo`.`effective_end_date` >= TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'DD')
  AND `persondpeo`.`effective_start_date` <= TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'DD')
  AND `persondpeo`.`person_id` = `personpeo`.`person_id`
JOIN `per_person_names_f_v` AS `personnamedpeo`
  ON `personnamedpeo`.`effective_end_date` >= TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'DD')
  AND `personnamedpeo`.`effective_start_date` <= TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'DD')
  AND `personnamedpeo`.`person_id` = `personpeo`.`person_id`
JOIN `per_all_assignments_m` AS `assignmentdpeo`
  ON `assignmentdpeo`.`effective_end_date` >= TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'DD')
  AND `assignmentdpeo`.`effective_latest_change` = 'Y'
  AND `assignmentdpeo`.`effective_start_date` <= TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'DD')
  AND `assignmentdpeo`.`person_id` = `personpeo`.`person_id`
  AND NOT `assignmentdpeo`.`work_terms_assignment_id` IS NULL
LEFT JOIN `_u_0` AS `_u_0`
  ON `_u_0`.`_u_1` = `assignmentdpeo`.`assignment_id`
WHERE
  NOT `_u_0`.`_u_1` IS NULL
ORDER BY
  `personnamedpeo`.`display_name` NULLS LAST

, RD.PJC_CONTRACT_ID CONTRACT_ID/*Added fOR

, RD.PJC_RESERVED_ATTRIBUTE1 FUNDING_SOURCE_ID/*Added fOR
grants uptake*/
, RD.PJC_FUNDING_ALLOCATION_ID FUNDING_ALLOCATION_ID/*Added fOR
grants uptake*/
, RD.PJC_CONTRACT_LINE_ID CONTRACT_LINE_ID/*Added fOR
grants uptake*/
FROM

PER_PERSON_NAMES_F_V REQ,

POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL RH,
PJF_TASKS_V T,
HR_ORGANIZATION_V O,
PJF_EXP_TYPES_VL ET,
POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL RD,
PJF_PROJECTS_ALL_VL P,
PJF_EXP_CATEGORIES_VL CAT,
FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V FABUV
WHERE
RH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = RL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
AND
RH.DOCUMENT_STATUS IN ('APPROVED','PENDING APPROVAL','RETURNED','WITHDRAWN')
AND
((RL.PO_LINE_ID IS NULL) OR
(RL.PO_LINE_ID IS NOT NULL
AND
NOT EXISTS (SELECT
1
FROM
PO_HEADERS_ALL POH,
PO_LINES_ALL POL,
PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLL
WHERE
NVL(POH.DOCUMENT_STATUS,'INCOMPLETE') IN ('CANCELED','CLOSED','FINALLY CLOSED','PENDING APPROVAL','OPEN','CLOSED FOR
INVOICING','CLOSED FOR
RECEIVING','ON HOLD','PENDING CATALOG AUTHORING','PENDING ACKNOWLEDGMENT' )
AND
NVL(PLL.SCHEDULE_STATUS,'INCOMPLETE') IN ('CANCELED','CLOSED','FINALLY CLOSED','PENDING APPROVAL','OPEN','CLOSED FOR
INVOICING','CLOSED FOR
RECEIVING','ON HOLD','PENDING CATALOG AUTHORING','PENDING ACKNOWLEDGMENT' )
AND
POL.PO_HEADER_ID = POH.PO_HEADER_ID
AND
POL.PO_LINE_ID = PLL.PO_LINE_ID
AND
POL.PO_LINE_ID = RL.PO_LINE_ID ) ) )
AND
NVL(RL.LINE_STATUS,'APPROVED') IN ('APPROVED','PENDING APPROVAL','RETURNED','ON_HOLD','WITHDRAWN')
AND
NVL(RL.MODIFIED_BY_BUYER_FLAG,'N') = 'N'
AND
REQ.PERSON_ID = RL.REQUESTER_ID
AND
TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(REQ.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND
NVL(REQ.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND
RL.LINE_TYPE_ID = LT.LINE_TYPE_ID
AND
RL.DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE = 'EXPENSE'
AND
RD.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = RL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
AND
RD.PJC_PROJECT_ID = P.PROJECT_ID
AND
RD.PJC_TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID
AND
RD.PJC_ORGANIZATION_ID = O.ORGANIZATION_ID
AND
RD.PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID = ET.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
AND
RD.DISTRIBUTION_AMOUNT <> 0 /*Added FOR
bug 17840243*/
AND
RH.REQ_BU_ID = FABUV.BU_ID
AND
G.LEDGER_ID = FABUV.PRIMARY_LEDGER_ID
AND
NVL(LT.MATCHING_BASIS,'QUANTITY') IN ('QUANTITY', 'AMOUNT')
AND
CAT.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID = ET.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID
AND
O.CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'PA_EXPENDITURE_ORG'
AND
NVL(RD.PJC_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) BETWEEN NVL(O.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND
NVL(O.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,TRUNC(SYSDATE))

JOIN "pjf_projects_all_b" "pp"

JOIN "pjf_proj_elements_b" "pt"

JOIN "pjf_txn_doc_entry_vl" "txn_doc_entry"
  ON "exp"."doc_entry_id" = "txn_doc_entry"."doc_entry_id"
JOIN "pjf_txn_sources_vl" "txn_src"

PJC_XLA_EMPLOYEE_REF_V.query:
SELECT
  "personname"."list_name" AS "person_name",
  "person"."person_number" AS "person_number",
  "personassignment"."person_type_id" AS "person_type",
  "person"."person_id" AS "person_id",
  "person"."effective_start_date" AS "person_effective_start_date",
  "person"."effective_end_date" AS "person_effective_end_date",
  "personassignment"."assignment_id" AS "assignment_id",
  "personassignment"."assignment_name" AS "assignment_name",
  "personassignment"."assignment_number" AS "assignment_number",
  "personassignment"."default_code_comb_id" AS "person_account_ccid",
  "personassignment"."business_unit_id" AS "person_bu",
  "personassignment"."legal_entity_id" AS "person_legal_entity_name",
  "personassignment"."organization_id" AS "department_name",
  "personassignment"."system_person_type" AS "system_person_type",
  "personassignment"."employment_category" AS "emp_assignment_category"
FROM "per_all_people_f" "person"
JOIN "per_all_assignments_f" "personassignment"
  ON "person"."person_id" = "personassignment"."person_id"
  AND "personassignment"."effective_latest_change" = 'Y'
  AND TRUNC("personassignment"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("personassignment"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND NOT "personassignment"."person_type_id" IS NULL
JOIN "per_person_names_f" "personname"
  ON "person"."person_id" = "personname"."person_id"
  AND "personname"."name_type" = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TRUNC("personname"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("personname"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
WHERE
  TRUNC("person"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("person"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')

PJC_XLA_ITEM_CAT_REF_V.query:
SELECT
  "exp"."expenditure_item_id" AS "exp_item_id",
  "pol"."category_id" AS "item_category"
FROM "pjc_exp_items_all" "exp"
JOIN "po_lines_all" "pol"
  ON "exp"."parent_line_number" = "pol"."po_line_id"
JOIN "pjf_txn_sources_b" "tsrc"
  ON "exp"."transaction_source_id" = "tsrc"."transaction_source_id"
  AND "tsrc"."predefined_flag" = 'Y'
  AND "tsrc"."transaction_source" = 'OSCM'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "exp"."expenditure_item_id" AS "exp_item_id",
  "pol"."category_id" AS "item_category"
FROM "pjc_exp_items_all" "exp"
JOIN "ap_invoice_distributions_all" "apdist"
  ON "apdist"."invoice_distribution_id" = "exp"."parent_line_number"
JOIN "pjf_txn_sources_b" "tsrc"
  ON "exp"."transaction_source_id" = "tsrc"."transaction_source_id"
  AND "tsrc"."predefined_flag" = 'Y'
  AND "tsrc"."transaction_source" = 'OAP'
JOIN "po_distributions_all" "podist"
  ON "apdist"."po_distribution_id" = "podist"."po_distribution_id"
JOIN "po_line_locations_all" "pll"
  ON "pll"."line_location_id" = "podist"."line_location_id"
JOIN "po_lines_all" "pol"
  ON "pll"."po_line_id" = "pol"."po_line_id"
PJC_XLA_ITEM_CAT_REF_V.query_databricks:

JOIN `pjf_txn_sources_b` AS `tsrc`

UNION ALL
SELECT

FROM `pjc_exp_items_all` AS `exp`

  ON `apdist`.`invoice_distribution_id` = `exp`.`parent_line_number`

  "ld"."person_id" AS "person_id",
  "personname"."list_name" AS "person_name",
  "person"."person_number" AS "person_number",

  ON "ld"."person_id" = "person"."person_id"
  AND TRUNC("person"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')

JOIN "per_all_assignments_f" "personassignment"
  ON "ld"."assignment_id" = "personassignment"."assignment_id"
  AND "ld"."person_id" = "personassignment"."person_id"
  AND TRUNC("personassignment"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("personassignment"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
JOIN "per_person_names_f_v" "personname"
  ON "person"."person_id" = "personname"."person_id"
  AND TRUNC("personname"."effective_end_date", 'DD') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND TRUNC("personname"."effective_start_date", 'DD') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')

PJC_XLA_ORIG_RAW_CR_REF_V.query:
SELECT
MAX(DECODE(xpap.program_code, 'PJC_RAW_COST_CREDIT',code_combination_id, NULL)) SOURCE_RAW_CR_ACCOUNT_CCID,
xdl.source_distribution_id_num_1,
nvl(xdl.source_distribution_id_num_2,-1) source_distribution_id_num_2,
xdl.source_distribution_type,
xdl.application_id,
gl.ledger_id
FROM
XLA_Distribution_Links xdl,
XLA_Ae_Headers aeh ,
XLA_Ae_Lines ael ,
XLA_Acct_Class_Assgns xaca ,
XLA_Assignment_Defns_b xad ,
XLA_Post_acct_Progs_b xpap ,
gl_ledgers gl
WHERE
xdl.ae_header_id = aeh.ae_header_id
AND
xdl.ae_line_num = ael.ae_line_num
AND
xdl.ae_header_id = ael.ae_header_id
AND
aeh.application_id = ael.application_id
AND
ael.application_id = xdl.application_id
AND
aeh.balance_type_code = 'A'
AND
NVL(aeh.multiperiod_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND
aeh.ledger_id = gl.ledger_id
AND
ael.accounting_class_code = xaca.accounting_class_code
AND
xaca.program_code = xad.program_code
AND
xaca.program_owner_code = xad.program_owner_code
AND
xad.program_code = xpap.program_code
AND
xpap.program_owner_code = 'S'
AND
xaca.assignment_code = xad.assignment_code
AND
xaca.assignment_owner_code = xad.assignment_owner_code
AND
xpap.application_id = 10036
AND
(xad.ledger_id IS NULL
OR
xad.ledger_id = gl.ledger_id)
AND
xad.enabled_flag = 'Y'
AND
xpap.program_code = 'PJC_RAW_COST_CREDIT'
AND
(NOT EXISTS
(Select 1
FROM
xla_ae_headers h, xla_ae_lines l,xla_distribution_links d
WHERE
h.ae_header_id = l.ae_header_id
AND
h.application_id = l.application_id
AND
h.event_id = aeh.event_id
AND
NVL(h.multiperiod_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND
h.ledger_id = aeh.ledger_id
AND
l.overridden_code_combination_id is not null
AND
l.accounting_class_code = ael.accounting_class_code
AND

substr( scbp, instr(scbp,'-',1,2)+1,
instr(scbp,'-',1,3)-instr(scbp,'-',1,2)-1))) level8_node_id,
decode(DISTANCE, 1, node_id,
substr( scbp, instr(scbp,'-',1,1)+1,
instr(scbp,'-',1,2)-instr(scbp,'-',1,1)-1)) level9_node_id,
substr( scbp, instr(scbp,'-',1,1)+1,
instr(scbp,'-',1,2)-instr(scbp,'-',1,1)-1) level10_node_id,
DISTANCE
from
(SELECT
sys_connect_by_path (node_id, '-') || '-' scbp,
level DISTANCE, node_id
FROM
pjf_eps_hierarchies
WHERE
node_type_code in ('R','U','S')
CONNECT BY PRIOR
node_id = parent_node_id
START WITH node_type_code = 'R')

PJF_EXP_TYPES_EXPEND_T_V.query:
SELECT
  "et"."expenditure_type_id" AS "expenditure_type_id",
  "et"."expenditure_type_name" || ' - ' || "sl"."meaning" AS "expenditure_type_name",
  "sl"."meaning" AS "system_linkage_m",
  "es"."system_linkage_function" AS "system_linkage_function",
  "et"."description" AS "description",
  "ec"."expenditure_category_name" AS "expenditure_category_name",
  "ec"."expenditure_category_id" AS "expenditure_category_id",
  "et"."unit_of_measure" AS "uom_code",
  "unit"."unit_of_measure" AS "unit_of_measure",
  "et"."proceeds_flag" AS "proceeds_flag",
  "et"."cost_rate_flag" AS "cost_rate_flag",
  "es"."start_date_active" AS "sys_link_start_date_active",
  "es"."end_date_active" AS "sys_link_end_date_active",
  "et"."start_date_active" AS "expnd_typ_start_date_active",
  "et"."end_date_active" AS "expnd_typ_end_date_active",
  "fsa"."determinant_value" AS "project_unit_id"
FROM "pjf_units_of_measure_v" "unit"
JOIN "pjf_exp_types_vl" "et"
  ON "et"."unit_of_measure" = "unit"."uom_code"
JOIN "pjf_exp_categories_vl" "ec"
  ON "ec"."expenditure_category_id" = "et"."expenditure_category_id"
JOIN "pjf_expend_typ_sys_links" "es"
  ON "es"."expenditure_type_id" = "et"."expenditure_type_id"
  AND "es"."system_linkage_function" IN ('OT', 'ST')
JOIN "pjf_exp_types_b_st" "pts"
  ON "et"."expenditure_type_id" = "pts"."expenditure_type_id"
JOIN "fnd_setid_assignments" "fsa"
  ON "fsa"."determinant_type" = 'PU'
  AND "fsa"."reference_group_name" = 'PJF_TRANSACTION_TYPES'
  AND "fsa"."set_id" = "pts"."set_id"
JOIN "pjf_system_linkages_vl" "sl"
  ON "es"."system_linkage_function" = "sl"."function"
ORDER BY
  "et"."expenditure_type_name",
  "es"."system_linkage_function"
PJF_EXP_TYPES_EXPEND_T_V.query_databricks:

  `fsa`.`determinant_value` AS `project_unit_id`

PJF_PROJECTS_BASIC_V.query:
SELECT
  "p"."project_id" AS "project_id",
  "p"."segment1" AS "segment1",
  "p"."name" AS "name",
  "p"."description" AS "description",
  "p"."project_type_id" AS "project_type_id",
  "p"."carrying_out_organization_id" AS "carrying_out_organization_id",
  "p"."project_status_code" AS "project_status_code",
  "p"."project_unit_id" AS "project_unit_id",
  NVL("p"."template_flag", 'N') AS "TEMPLATE_FLAG",
  "prjty"."enable_billing_flag" AS "BILLABLE_FLAG",
  "prjty"."enable_capitalization_flag" AS "CAPITALIZATION_FLAG",
  "p"."pm_project_reference" AS "pm_project_reference",
  "p"."org_id" AS "org_id",
  "p"."start_date" AS "start_date",
  "p"."completion_date" AS "completion_date",
  "p"."project_currency_code" AS "project_currency_code",
  "p"."allow_cross_charge_flag" AS "allow_cross_charge_flag",
  "ledger"."org_information3" AS "primary_ledger_id",
  "p"."projfunc_currency_code" AS "projfunc_currency_code",
  "p"."project_category" AS "project_category",
  "p"."project_calendar_id" AS "project_calendar_id",
  "p"."hours_per_day" AS "hours_per_day",
  "p"."external_project_id" AS "external_project_id",
  "bu"."name" AS "bu_name",
  "pu"."name" AS "pu_name"
FROM "pjf_projects_all_vl" "p"
JOIN "hr_organization_units_f_tl" "bu"
  ON "bu"."effective_end_date" >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "bu"."effective_start_date" <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "bu"."language" = USERENV('LANG')
  AND "bu"."organization_id" = "p"."org_id"
JOIN "hr_organization_information_x" "ledger"
  ON "ledger"."org_information_context" = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
  AND "ledger"."organization_id" = "p"."org_id"
JOIN "pjf_project_types_b" "prjty"
  ON "p"."project_type_id" = "prjty"."project_type_id"
JOIN "hr_organization_units_f_tl" "pu"
  ON "p"."project_unit_id" = "pu"."organization_id"
  AND "pu"."effective_end_date" >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "pu"."effective_start_date" <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
  AND "pu"."language" = USERENV('LANG')
WHERE
  NVL("p"."template_flag", 'N') <> 'Y'

PJF_UNITS_OF_MEASURE_V.query:
SELECT
  "inv_uom"."uom_code" AS "uom_code",
  "inv_uom"."unit_of_measure" AS "unit_of_measure",
  "inv_uom"."description" AS "description",
  CASE
    WHEN NVL("inv_uom"."disable_date", TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD') + 1) > TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
    THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS "enabled_flag"
FROM "inv_units_of_measure_vl" "inv_uom"
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "prj_uom"."lookup_code" AS "uom_code",
  "prj_uom"."meaning" AS "unit_of_measure",
  "prj_uom"."description" AS "description",
  CASE
    WHEN (
      "prj_uom"."enabled_flag" = 'Y'
      AND "prj_uom"."start_date_active" <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
      AND NVL("prj_uom"."end_date_active", TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
    )
    THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS "enabled_flag"
FROM "fnd_lookup_values_vl" "prj_uom"
WHERE
  "prj_uom"."lookup_type" = 'PJF_UNIT'
  AND "prj_uom"."set_id" = 0
  AND "prj_uom"."view_application_id" = 0

  "et"."end_date_active" AS "end_date_active",
  "fsa"."determinant_value" AS "project_unit_id",
  "ppa"."project_id" AS "project_id"
FROM "pjf_work_types_vl" "et"
JOIN "pjf_work_types_b_st" "pts"
  ON "et"."work_type_id" = "pts"."work_type_id"
JOIN "fnd_setid_assignments" "fsa"
  ON "fsa"."determinant_type" = 'PU'
  AND "fsa"."reference_group_name" = 'PJF_TRANSACTION_TYPES'
  AND "fsa"."set_id" = "pts"."set_id"
JOIN "pjf_projects_all_b" "ppa"
  ON "fsa"."determinant_value" = "ppa"."project_unit_id"
  AND "ppa"."project_category" = 'FIN_EXEC'

SUM(DECODE(RBS_AGGR_LEVEL,'T',NULL,TC_ACT_BRDN_COST)) RR_TC_ACT_BRDN_COST,

SUM(DECODE(RBS_AGGR_LEVEL,'T',NULL,ACT_LABOR_HRS)) RR_ACT_LABOR_HRS,
SUM(DECODE(RBS_AGGR_LEVEL,'T',NULL,ACT_EQUIP_HRS)) RR_ACT_EQUIP_HRS
FROM
PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_B WBS, PJO_XBS_ACCUM_F FACT, PJO_PLANNING_OPTIONS PPO
WHERE
FACT.PROJECT_ID = WBS.PROJECT_ID AND
FACT.PLAN_VERSION_ID = WBS.PLAN_VERSION_ID AND
(WBS.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'W'
AND
WBS.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
AND
(FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL = 'T'
OR
(FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL in ('L','R')
AND
FACT.WBS_ROLLUP_FLAG = 'N'))) AND
PPO.PLAN_VERSION_ID = WBS.PLAN_VERSION_ID
AND
FACT.PERIOD_TYPE_ID = DECODE(PPO.TIME_PHASED_CODE,'N',2048,32)

FACT.START_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND
WBS.STRUCTURE_VERSION_ID IS NOT NULL

WBS.PROJECT_ID ,
WBS.STRUCTURE_VERSION_ID ,
FACT.PROJECT_ORG_ID ,
FACT.PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID ,
DECODE(FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL,'R','L',FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL),
DECODE(FACT.WBS_ROLLUP_FLAG,'Y','N','N'),
FACT.RBS_VERSION_ID ,
FACT.RBS_ELEMENT_ID ,
WBS.PLAN_VERSION_ID
) pr
WHERE
cr.PROJECT_ID = pr.PROJECT_ID(+) AND
cr.STRUCTURE_VERSION_ID = pr.STRUCTURE_VERSION_ID (+) AND
cr.PROJECT_ORG_ID = pr.PROJECT_ORG_ID(+) AND
cr.PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID = pr.PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID(+) AND
cr.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL = pr.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL(+) AND
cr.WBS_ROLLUP_FLAG = pr.WBS_ROLLUP_FLAG(+) AND
cr.RBS_VERSION_ID = pr.RBS_VERSION_ID(+) AND
cr.RBS_ELEMENT_ID = pr.RBS_ELEMENT_ID(+) AND
cr.plan_version_id = pr.plan_version_id(+) AND
NVL(cr.CURRENCY_CODE,'TXN') = NVL(pr.CURRENCY_CODE(+),'TXN')

WITH "_u_0" AS (
  SELECT
    ARRAY_AGG(DECODE((
      "a"."version_number" - 1
    ), 0, -99, (
      "a"."version_number" - 1
    ))) AS "_col_0",
    "a"."plan_type_id" AS "_u_1",
    "a"."project_id" AS "_u_2"
  FROM "pjo_plan_versions_b" "a"
  WHERE
    "a"."current_plan_status_flag" = 'Y'
    AND "a"."plan_class_code" = 'FORECAST'
    AND "a"."plan_status_code" = 'B'
  GROUP BY
    "a"."plan_type_id",
    "a"."project_id"
)
SELECT
  "planlineeo"."plan_line_id" AS "plan_line_id",
  "planversioneo"."plan_version_id" AS "plan_version_id",
  "planversioneo"."plan_type_id" AS "plan_type_id",
  "planversioneo"."project_id" AS "project_id",
  "planlineeo"."planning_element_id" AS "planning_element_id",
  "planlineeo"."txn_currency_code" AS "txn_currency_code",
  "planlineeo"."total_quantity" AS "total_quantity",
  "planlineeo"."total_act_quantity" AS "total_act_quantity",
  NULLIF(
    (
      NVL("planlineeo"."total_quantity", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_act_quantity", 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS "total_etc_quantity",
  "planlineeo"."total_tc_raw_cost" AS "total_tc_raw_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_tc_act_raw_cost" AS "total_tc_act_raw_cost",
  NULLIF(
    (
      NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_raw_cost", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_raw_cost", 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS "total_tc_etc_raw_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_tc_brdnd_cost" AS "total_tc_brdnd_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_tc_act_brdnd_cost" AS "total_tc_act_brdnd_cost",
  NULLIF(
    (
      NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_brdnd_cost", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_brdnd_cost", 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS "total_tc_etc_brdnd_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_tc_revenue" AS "total_tc_revenue",
  "planlineeo"."total_tc_act_revenue" AS "total_tc_act_revenue",
  NULLIF(
    (
      NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_revenue", 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS "total_tc_etc_revenue",
  DECODE(
    "pjoplanningoptions"."margin_derived_from_code",
    'B',
    DECODE(
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_brdnd_cost", 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_brdnd_cost", 0)
      )
    ),
    DECODE(
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_raw_cost", 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_raw_cost", 0)
      )
    )
  ) AS "total_tc_margin",
  DECODE(
    "pjoplanningoptions"."margin_derived_from_code",
    'B',
    DECODE(
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_brdnd_cost", 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_brdnd_cost", 0)
      )
    ),
    DECODE(
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_raw_cost", 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_revenue", 0) - NVL("planlineeo"."total_tc_act_raw_cost", 0)
      )
    )
  ) AS "total_tc_act_margin",
  "planlineeo"."total_pc_raw_cost" AS "pc_raw_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_pfc_raw_cost" AS "pfc_raw_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_pc_brdnd_cost" AS "pc_brdnd_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_pfc_brdnd_cost" AS "pfc_brdnd_cost",
  "planlineeo"."total_pc_revenue" AS "pc_revenue",
  "planlineeo"."total_pfc_revenue" AS "pfc_revenue",
  "pjoplanningoptions"."margin_derived_from_code" AS "margin_derived_from_code",
  "planningelementeo"."task_id" AS "task_id",
  "planningelementeo"."rbs_element_id" AS "rbs_element_id"
FROM "pjo_plan_lines" "planlineeo"
JOIN "pjo_planning_elements" "planningelementeo"
  ON "planlineeo"."planning_element_id" = "planningelementeo"."planning_element_id"
JOIN "pjo_plan_versions_b" "planversioneo"
  ON "planlineeo"."plan_version_id" = "planversioneo"."plan_version_id"
  AND "planningelementeo"."plan_version_id" = "planversioneo"."plan_version_id"
  AND "planversioneo"."current_plan_status_flag" = 'Y'
  AND "planversioneo"."plan_class_code" = 'FORECAST'
  AND "planversioneo"."plan_status_code" = 'B'
JOIN "pjo_planning_options" "pjoplanningoptions"
  ON "pjoplanningoptions"."plan_version_id" = "planlineeo"."plan_version_id"
  AND "pjoplanningoptions"."plan_version_id" = "planningelementeo"."plan_version_id"
  AND "pjoplanningoptions"."plan_version_id" = "planversioneo"."plan_version_id"
LEFT JOIN "_u_0" "_u_0"
  ON "_u_0"."_u_1" = "planversioneo"."plan_type_id"

PJO_DIS_NON_PD_PRIOR_V.query_databricks:
WITH `_u_0` AS (
  SELECT
    COLLECT_LIST(DECODE((
      `a`.`version_number` - 1
    ), 0, -99, (
      `a`.`version_number` - 1
    ))) AS `_col_0`,
    `a`.`plan_type_id` AS `_u_1`,
    `a`.`project_id` AS `_u_2`
  FROM `pjo_plan_versions_b` AS `a`
  WHERE
    `a`.`current_plan_status_flag` = 'Y'
    AND `a`.`plan_class_code` = 'FORECAST'
    AND `a`.`plan_status_code` = 'B'
  GROUP BY
    `a`.`plan_type_id`,
    `a`.`project_id`
)
SELECT
  `planlineeo`.`plan_line_id` AS `plan_line_id`,
  `planversioneo`.`plan_version_id` AS `plan_version_id`,
  `planversioneo`.`plan_type_id` AS `plan_type_id`,
  `planversioneo`.`project_id` AS `project_id`,
  `planlineeo`.`planning_element_id` AS `planning_element_id`,
  `planlineeo`.`txn_currency_code` AS `txn_currency_code`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_quantity` AS `total_quantity`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_act_quantity` AS `total_act_quantity`,
  NULLIF(
    (
      COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_quantity`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_act_quantity`, 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS `total_etc_quantity`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_tc_raw_cost` AS `total_tc_raw_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_raw_cost` AS `total_tc_act_raw_cost`,
  NULLIF(
    (
      COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_raw_cost`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_raw_cost`, 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS `total_tc_etc_raw_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_tc_brdnd_cost` AS `total_tc_brdnd_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_brdnd_cost` AS `total_tc_act_brdnd_cost`,
  NULLIF(
    (
      COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_brdnd_cost`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_brdnd_cost`, 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS `total_tc_etc_brdnd_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_tc_revenue` AS `total_tc_revenue`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_revenue` AS `total_tc_act_revenue`,
  NULLIF(
    (
      COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_revenue`, 0)
    ),
    0
  ) AS `total_tc_etc_revenue`,
  DECODE(
    `pjoplanningoptions`.`margin_derived_from_code`,
    'B',
    DECODE(
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_brdnd_cost`, 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_brdnd_cost`, 0)
      )
    ),
    DECODE(
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_raw_cost`, 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_raw_cost`, 0)
      )
    )
  ) AS `total_tc_margin`,
  DECODE(
    `pjoplanningoptions`.`margin_derived_from_code`,
    'B',
    DECODE(
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_brdnd_cost`, 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_brdnd_cost`, 0)
      )
    ),
    DECODE(
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_raw_cost`, 0)
      ),
      0,
      NULL,
      (
        COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_revenue`, 0) - COALESCE(`planlineeo`.`total_tc_act_raw_cost`, 0)
      )
    )
  ) AS `total_tc_act_margin`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_pc_raw_cost` AS `pc_raw_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_pfc_raw_cost` AS `pfc_raw_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_pc_brdnd_cost` AS `pc_brdnd_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_pfc_brdnd_cost` AS `pfc_brdnd_cost`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_pc_revenue` AS `pc_revenue`,
  `planlineeo`.`total_pfc_revenue` AS `pfc_revenue`,
  `pjoplanningoptions`.`margin_derived_from_code` AS `margin_derived_from_code`,
  `planningelementeo`.`task_id` AS `task_id`,
  `planningelementeo`.`rbs_element_id` AS `rbs_element_id`
FROM `pjo_plan_lines` AS `planlineeo`
JOIN `pjo_planning_elements` AS `planningelementeo`
  ON `planlineeo`.`planning_element_id` = `planningelementeo`.`planning_element_id`
JOIN `pjo_plan_versions_b` AS `planversioneo`
  ON `planlineeo`.`plan_version_id` = `planversioneo`.`plan_version_id`
  AND `planningelementeo`.`plan_version_id` = `planversioneo`.`plan_version_id`
  AND `planversioneo`.`current_plan_status_flag` = 'Y'
  AND `planversioneo`.`plan_class_code` = 'FORECAST'
  AND `planversioneo`.`plan_status_code` = 'B'
JOIN `pjo_planning_options` AS `pjoplanningoptions`
  ON `pjoplanningoptions`.`plan_version_id` = `planlineeo`.`plan_version_id`
  AND `pjoplanningoptions`.`plan_version_id` = `planningelementeo`.`plan_version_id`
  AND `pjoplanningoptions`.`plan_version_id` = `planversioneo`.`plan_version_id`
LEFT JOIN `_u_0` AS `_u_0`
  ON `_u_0`.`_u_1` = `planversioneo`.`plan_type_id`
  AND `_u_0`.`_u_2` = `planversioneo`.`project_id`
WHERE
  `_u_0`.`_col_0` = `planversioneo`.`version_number`

  `ppe`.`planning_start_date` AS `planning_start_date`,

  `ppe`.`unit_of_measure` AS `unit_of_measure`,
  `ppe`.`spread_curve_id` AS `spread_curve_id`,

      `ppd`.`start_date`
    ),
    'Succeeding Period',
    DECODE(
      SIGN(`ppd`.`start_date` - `ppe`.`planning_start_date`),
      -1,
      `pjo_edit_plan_setup`.get_period_start_date(`ppe`.`planning_start_date`, `ppj`.`org_id`, `ppo`.`time_phased_code`),
      `ppd`.`start_date`
    ),
    `ppd`.`start_date`
  ) AS `start_date`,
  `ppd`.`current_reporting_period` AS `current_reporting_period`,
  DECODE(
    `ppd`.`period_prompt`,
    'Succeeding Period',
    DECODE(
      SIGN(`ppd`.`end_date` - `ppe`.`planning_end_date`),
      -1,
      `ppd`.`end_date`,
      `pjo_edit_plan_setup`.get_period_end_date(`ppe`.`planning_end_date`, `ppj`.`org_id`, `ppo`.`time_phased_code`)
    ),
    'Preceding Period',
    DECODE(
      SIGN(`ppd`.`end_date` - `ppe`.`planning_end_date`),
      -1,
      `ppd`.`end_date`,
      `pjo_edit_plan_setup`.get_period_end_date(`ppe`.`planning_end_date`, `ppj`.`org_id`, `ppo`.`time_phased_code`)
    ),
    `ppd`.`end_date`
  ) AS `end_date`,
  `ppd`.`from_anchor_position` AS `from_anchor_position`,
  `ppd`.`period_prompt` AS `period_prompt`,
  `ppd`.`start_period_name` AS `start_period_name`,
  `ppd`.`end_period_name` AS `end_period_name`,
  `ppd`.`period_profile_id` AS `period_profile_id`,

  `ppl`.`addl_attribute_num_3` AS `addl_attribute_num_3`,
  `ppl`.`addl_attribute_num_8` AS `addl_attribute_num_8`
FROM `pjo_planning_elements` AS `ppe`
JOIN `pjo_dis_session_periods` AS `ppd`
  ON `ppd`.`end_date` >= `ppe`.`planning_start_date`
  AND `ppd`.`start_date` <= `ppe`.`planning_end_date`
JOIN `pjo_plan_lines` AS `ppl`
  ON `ppe`.`planning_element_id` = `ppl`.`planning_element_id`
JOIN `pjf_projects_all_b` AS `ppj`
  ON `ppd`.`org_id` = `ppj`.`org_id` AND `ppe`.`project_id` = `ppj`.`project_id`
JOIN `pjo_planning_options` AS `ppo`
  ON `ppd`.`current_reporting_period` = `ppo`.`current_planning_period`
  AND `ppd`.`period_profile_id` = `ppo`.`period_profile_id`
  AND `ppe`.`plan_version_id` = `ppo`.`plan_version_id`

FROM `pjo_planning_elements` AS `ppe`
JOIN `pjf_projects_all_b` AS `ppj`

JOIN `pjo_plan_lines` AS `ppl`

JOIN `pjo_plan_versions_b` AS `ppv`

JOIN `gms_awd_str_end_pr_date_v` AS `gms`

PJO_DIS_PD_PRIOR_DTL_V.query:
SELECT
ppd.period_name,
ppd.start_date,
ppd.end_date,
ppd.from_anchor_start,
ppd.planning_element_id,
ppd.period_profile_id,
ppd.current_period_name,
ppd.project_id,
ppd.object_id1,

ppd.txn_currency_code,
ppd.plan_Version_id,

ppd.PLANNING_START_DATE,
ppd.PLANNING_END_DATE,
ppd.UNIT_OF_MEASURE,
ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,
decode(sum(ppld.quantity),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.quantity)) as QUANTITY,
decode(sum(ppld.tc_raw_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_raw_cost)) as TC_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pc_raw_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_raw_cost)) as PC_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pfc_raw_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_raw_cost)) as PFC_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost)) as TC_BRDND_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pc_brdnd_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_brdnd_cost)) as PC_BRDND_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pfc_brdnd_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_brdnd_cost)) as PFC_BRDND_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.tc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_revenue)) as TC_REVENUE,
decode(sum(ppld.pc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_revenue)) as PC_REVENUE,
decode(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_revenue)) as PFC_REVENUE,
DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.tc_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.tc_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_raw_cost))) as TC_MARGIN,
DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B', to_number(sum(ppld.pc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.pc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pc_raw_cost))) as PC_MARGIN,
DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B', to_number(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pfc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pfc_raw_cost))) as PFC_MARGIN,
decode(sum(ppld.act_quantity),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.act_quantity)) as ACT_QUANTITY,
decode(sum(ppld.tc_act_raw_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_act_raw_cost)) as TC_ACT_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pc_act_raw_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_act_raw_cost)) as PC_ACT_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pfc_act_raw_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_act_raw_cost)) as PFC_ACT_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.tc_act_brdnd_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_act_brdnd_cost)) as TC_ACT_BRDND_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pc_act_brdnd_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_act_brdnd_cost)) as PC_ACT_BRDND_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.pfc_act_brdnd_cost),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_act_brdnd_cost)) as PFC_ACT_BRDND_COST,
decode(sum(ppld.tc_act_revenue),0,to_number(null),sum(ppld.tc_act_revenue)) as TC_ACT_REVENUE,
decode(sum(ppld.pc_act_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_act_revenue)) as PC_ACT_REVENUE,
decode(sum(ppld.pfc_act_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_act_revenue)) as PFC_ACT_REVENUE,
DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.tc_act_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_act_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.tc_act_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_act_raw_cost))) as TC_ACT_MARGIN,
(decode(nvl(DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.tc_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.tc_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_raw_cost))), 0),0, to_number(NULL), DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.tc_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.tc_revenue) - sum(ppld.tc_raw_cost)))) / decode(nvl(decode(sum(ppld.tc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_revenue)), 0),0, to_number(NULL), decode(sum(ppld.tc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.tc_revenue)))) as TC_MARGIN_PCT,
(decode(nvl(DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.pc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.pc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pc_raw_cost))), 0),0, to_number(NULL), DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.pc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.pc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pc_raw_cost)))) / decode(nvl(decode(sum(ppld.pc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_revenue)), 0),0, to_number(NULL), decode(sum(ppld.pc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pc_revenue)))) as PC_MARGIN_PCT,
(decode(nvl(DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pfc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pfc_raw_cost))), 0),0, to_number(NULL), DECODE(ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE,'B',to_number(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pfc_brdnd_cost)),to_number(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue) - sum(ppld.pfc_raw_cost)))) / decode(nvl(decode(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_revenue)), 0),0, to_number(NULL), decode(sum(ppld.pfc_revenue),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppld.pfc_revenue)))) as PFC_MARGIN_PCT,
(sum( decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_bill_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_bill_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity) * nvl(ppld.tc_bill_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_bill_rate,0)))))/ decode(sum(decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_bill_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_bill_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity)))),0,NULL,sum(decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_bill_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_bill_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity)))))) as TC_BILL_RATE,
(sum( decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_raw_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_raw_cost_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity) * nvl(ppld.tc_raw_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_raw_cost_rate,0)))))/ decode(sum(decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_raw_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_raw_cost_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity)))),0,NULL,sum(decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_raw_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_raw_cost_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity)))))) as TC_RAW_COST_RATE,
(sum( decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_brdnd_cost_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity) * nvl(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_brdnd_cost_rate,0)))))/ decode(sum(decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_brdnd_cost_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity)))),0,NULL,sum(decode(ppld.quantity,0,null,decode(nvl(ppld.tc_brdnd_cost_rate_override,nvl(ppld.tc_std_brdnd_cost_rate,0)),0,null,(ppld.quantity)))))) as TC_BRDND_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL), (DECODE (SUM (ppld.tc_act_raw_cost),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.tc_act_raw_cost))/ SUM(ppld.act_quantity))) as TC_ACT_RAW_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL), (DECODE (SUM (ppld.pc_act_raw_cost),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.pc_act_raw_cost))/ SUM(ppld.act_quantity))) as PC_ACT_RAW_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL), (DECODE (SUM (ppld.pfc_act_raw_cost),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.pfc_act_raw_cost))/ SUM(ppld.act_quantity))) as PFC_ACT_RAW_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL), (DECODE (SUM (ppld.tc_act_brdnd_cost),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.tc_act_brdnd_cost))/ SUM(ppld.act_quantity))) as TC_ACT_BRDND_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL), (DECODE (SUM (ppld.pc_act_brdnd_cost),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.pc_act_brdnd_cost))/ SUM(ppld.act_quantity))) as PC_ACT_BRDND_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL), (DECODE (SUM (ppld.pfc_act_brdnd_cost),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.pfc_act_brdnd_cost))/ SUM(ppld.act_quantity))) as PFC_ACT_BRDND_COST_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL),(DECODE (SUM (ppld.tc_act_revenue),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.tc_act_revenue))/ SUM (ppld.act_quantity))) as TC_ACT_BILL_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL),(DECODE (SUM (ppld.pc_act_revenue),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.pc_act_revenue))/ SUM (ppld.act_quantity))) as PC_ACT_BILL_RATE,
DECODE (SUM (ppld.act_quantity),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),NULL, TO_NUMBER (NULL),(DECODE (SUM (ppld.pfc_act_revenue),0, TO_NUMBER (NULL),SUM (ppld.pfc_act_revenue))/ SUM (ppld.act_quantity))) as PFC_ACT_BILL_RATE
FROM
pjo_plan_line_details ppld, pjo_dis_pd_period_all_v ppd, pjo_plan_versions_b pvr
WHERE
ppld.start_date(+) >= ppd.start_date
AND
ppld.end_date(+) <= ppd.end_date
AND
ppld.planning_element_id(+) = ppd.planning_element_id
AND
ppld.txn_currency_code(+) = ppd.txn_currency_code
AND
ppd.plan_Version_id = pvr.plan_Version_id
AND
pvr.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG <> 'Y'
AND
pvr.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'B'
AND
pvr.version_number = ( Select Decode((PlanVersionEOPFVC.version_number-1),0,-99,(PlanVersionEOPFVC.version_number-1))
From pjo_plan_versions_b PlanVersionEOPFVC
Where PlanVersionEOPFVC.current_plan_status_flag = 'Y'
And PlanVersionEOPFVC.plan_status_code = 'B'
AND
pvr.plan_type_id = PlanVersionEOPFVC.plan_type_id
AND
pvr.project_id = PlanVersionEOPFVC.project_id )
GROUP BY
ppd.period_name, ppd.start_date, ppd.end_date, ppd.from_anchor_start, ppd.planning_element_id, ppd.period_profile_id, ppd.current_period_name, ppd.project_id, ppd.object_id1, ppd.task_id, ppd.rbs_element_id, ppd.txn_currency_code, ppd.plan_Version_id, ppd.plan_type_id,ppd.PLANNING_START_DATE, ppd.PLANNING_END_DATE, ppd.UNIT_OF_MEASURE, ppd.MARGIN_DERIVED_FROM_CODE
ORDER BY
ppd.start_date

decode(sum(ppe.pc_po_cmt_raw_cost), 0, to_number(null), sum(ppe.pc_po_cmt_raw_cost)) as pc_po_cmt_raw_cost,

decode(sum(ppe.pc_oth_cmt_brdn_cost), 0, to_number(null), sum(ppe.pc_oth_cmt_brdn_cost)) as pc_oth_cmt_brdn_cost,
decode(sum(ppe.CMT_TO_QUANTITY),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppe.CMT_TO_QUANTITY)) as CMT_TO_QUANTITY,
decode(sum(ppe.PC_TO_CMT_RAW_COST ),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppe.PC_TO_CMT_RAW_COST )) as PC_TO_CMT_RAW_COST,
decode(sum(ppe.PC_TO_CMT_BRDN_COST ),0,to_number(NULL),sum(ppe.PC_TO_CMT_BRDN_COST )) as PC_TO_CMT_BRDN_COST,

PJO_PROJ_PLAN_ANALYTICS_V.query:
SELECT
  "ppa"."project_id" AS "project_id",
  "ppa"."plan_version_id" AS "plan_version_id",
  "ppa"."measure_code" AS "measure_code",
  "lu"."meaning" || "ppa"."project_currency_code" AS "measure_description",
  "ppa"."plan_value_date" AS "plan_value_date",
  "ppa"."plan_value_number" AS "plan_value_number",
  "ppa"."baseline_value_date" AS "baseline_value_date",
  "ppa"."baseline_value_number" AS "baseline_value_number",
  "ppa"."plan_bas_variance" AS "plan_bas_variance",
  "ppa"."display_order" AS "display_order"
FROM "pjo_plan_versions_b" "pv"
JOIN TABLE(
  "pjo_task_assignment_utils".proj_plan_analytics("pv"."project_id", "pv"."plan_version_id")
) "ppa"
  ON "ppa"."plan_version_id" = "pv"."plan_version_id"
  AND "ppa"."project_id" = "pv"."project_id"
JOIN "pjo_lookups" "lu"
  ON "lu"."lookup_code" = "ppa"."measure_code"
  AND "lu"."lookup_type" = 'PJO_PROJ_PLAN_ANALYTICS'
WHERE
  "pv"."current_plan_status_flag" = 'Y'
  AND "pv"."plan_status_code" = 'W'
  AND NOT "pv"."structure_version_id" IS NULL
ORDER BY
  "ppa"."display_order"

FROM
PJO_PLAN_VERSIONS_B WBS, PJO_XBS_ACCUM_F FACT
WHERE
FACT.PROJECT_ID = WBS.PROJECT_ID AND
FACT.PLAN_VERSION_ID = WBS.PLAN_VERSION_ID AND
(WBS.PLAN_STATUS_CODE = 'W'
AND
WBS.CURRENT_PLAN_STATUS_FLAG = 'Y'
AND
(FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL = 'T'
OR
(FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL in ('L','R')
AND
FACT.WBS_ROLLUP_FLAG = 'N'))) AND
FACT.PERIOD_TYPE_ID = 32
AND
TRUNC(SYSDATE) NOT BETWEEN FACT.START_DATE
AND
FACT.END_DATE
AND
FACT.START_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND
WBS.STRUCTURE_VERSION_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
WBS.PROJECT_ID ,
WBS.STRUCTURE_VERSION_ID ,
FACT.PROJECT_ORG_ID ,
FACT.PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID ,
DECODE(FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL,'R','L',FACT.RBS_AGGR_LEVEL),
DECODE(FACT.WBS_ROLLUP_FLAG,'Y','N','N'),
FACT.RBS_VERSION_ID ,
FACT.RBS_ELEMENT_ID ,
WBS.PLAN_VERSION_ID
) pr

cr.PROJECT_ID = pr.PROJECT_ID(+) AND

cr.RBS_VERSION_ID = pr.RBS_VERSION_ID(+) AND
cr.RBS_ELEMENT_ID = pr.RBS_ELEMENT_ID(+) AND
cr.plan_version_id = pr.plan_version_id(+) AND
NVL(cr.CURRENCY_CODE,'TXN') = NVL(pr.CURRENCY_CODE(+),'TXN')

    )

FROM `pjo_plan_versions_b` AS `wbs`
JOIN `pjo_xbs_accum_f` AS `fact`
  ON `fact`.`period_type_id` = 2048
  AND `fact`.`plan_version_id` = `wbs`.`plan_version_id`
  AND `fact`.`project_id` = `wbs`.`project_id`
  AND (
    `fact`.`rbs_aggr_level` = 'T' OR `fact`.`rbs_aggr_level` IN ('L', 'R')
  )
  AND (
    `fact`.`rbs_aggr_level` = 'T' OR `fact`.`wbs_rollup_flag` = 'N'
  )
WHERE
  `wbs`.`current_plan_status_flag` = 'Y'
  AND (
    `wbs`.`plan_status_code` = 'B' OR `wbs`.`plan_status_code` = 'W'
  )
  AND NOT `wbs`.`structure_version_id` IS NULL
GROUP BY
  `wbs`.`project_id`,
  `wbs`.`structure_version_id`,
  `fact`.`project_org_id`,
  `fact`.`project_element_id`,
  DECODE(`fact`.`rbs_aggr_level`, 'R', 'L', `fact`.`rbs_aggr_level`),
  DECODE(`fact`.`wbs_rollup_flag`, 'Y', 'N', 'N'),
  `fact`.`rbs_version_id`,
  `fact`.`rbs_element_id`

PJO_RBS_DENORM_V.query:
SELECT
  "elem"."rbs_version_id" AS "rbs_version_id",
  CONNECT_BY_ROOT "elem"."rbs_element_id" AS "sub_emt_id",
  "elem"."parent_element_id" AS "sup_emt_id",
  (
    "elem"."rbs_level" - 1
  ) + "elem"."level" AS "sub_level",
  "elem"."rbs_level" - 1 AS "sup_level"
FROM "pjf_rbs_elements" "elem"
WHERE
  NOT "elem"."parent_element_id" IS NULL
CONNECT BY "elem"."rbs_element_id" = PRIOR "elem"."parent_element_id"

SELECT

,opt.PLAN_VERSION_ID
,opt.TXN_ACCUM_HEADER_ID
,opt.business_unit_id
,opt.PROJECT_ID
,opt.TASK_ID PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID
,opt.CALENDAR_TYPE
,opt.CURRENCY_TYPE
,opt.period_name
,opt.RAW_COST
,opt.BRDN_COST BRDND_COST
,opt.REVENUE

,PJS_RBS_HEADER rbs_hdr
,PJS_BU_INFO bu
,PJS_TIME_D TIME
,PJS_TIME_CAL_NAME cal

,PJS_PLAN_TYPES pt

pt.PLAN_TYPE_NUMBER IN (1,2)

'Y' = rbs.OLAP_SELF_NODE_FLAG(+)

SELECT
e.project_id as project_id, connect_by_root e.name as task_name,

pl.rollup_plan_line as is_task,
decode(pl.rollup_plan_line,'Y',pl.physical_percent_complete) as physical_percent_complete,
decode(pl.rollup_plan_line,'N',pl.resource_id) as resource_id,
decode(pl.rollup_plan_line,'N',pl.labor_cost_amount) as labor_cost_amount,
decode(pl.rollup_plan_line,'N',pl.expense_cost_amount) as expense_cost_amount,
decode(pl.rollup_plan_line,'N',r.person_id) as person_id,

decode(pl.rollup_plan_line,'N',r.currency_code) as currency_code,

    AND (

    AND (

    )

PJT_RES_MONTHLY_ALLOC_HRS_V.query:
WITH "a" AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "prjres"."resource_id" AS "resource_id",
    "res"."person_id" AS "person_id",
    "res"."email" AS "email",
    NVL("prj"."project_calendar_id", -99) AS "schedule_id",
    "prj"."project_id" AS "project_id",
    "prjres"."project_role_id" AS "project_role_id",
    TRUNC(NVL("prjres"."start_date_active", "prj"."start_date"), 'DD') AS "res_start_date",
    TRUNC(NVL("prjres"."end_date_active", NVL("prj"."completion_date", SYSDATE + 366)), 'DD') AS "res_end_date",
    "prjres"."allocation" AS "allocation"
  FROM "fusion"."pjt_project_resource" "prjres"
  JOIN "fusion"."pjf_projects_all_vl" "prj"
    ON "prj"."project_category" IN ('EXECUTION', 'FIN_EXEC')
    AND "prj"."project_id" = "prjres"."project_id"
    AND "prj"."project_status_code" <> 'CLOSED'
    AND NVL("prj"."template_flag", 'N') <> 'Y'
  JOIN "fusion"."pjt_prj_enterprise_resource_vl" "res"
    ON "prjres"."resource_id" = "res"."resource_id"
    AND "res"."resource_class" = 'PEOPLE'
)
SELECT
  "a"."resource_id" AS "resource_id",
  "a"."project_id" AS "project_id",
  "a"."project_role_id" AS "project_role_id",
  "a"."res_start_date" AS "res_start_date",
  LAST_DAY("dlyhrs"."start_date") AS "cy_period_end_date",
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      DECODE(
        SIGN("dlyhrs"."start_date" - "a"."res_start_date"),
        -1,
        0,
        DECODE(
          SIGN("a"."res_end_date" - "dlyhrs"."start_date"),
          -1,
          0,
          "dlyhrs"."hours" * "a"."allocation" / 100
        )
      )
    ),
    2
  ) AS "allocated_hours"
FROM "a" "a"
JOIN "fusion"."pjt_zmm_schedule_dtls_v" "dlyhrs"
  ON "a"."schedule_id" = "dlyhrs"."schedule_id"
GROUP BY
  "a"."resource_id",
  "a"."project_id",
  "a"."project_role_id",
  "a"."res_start_date",
  LAST_DAY("dlyhrs"."start_date")

  TRUNC(`a`.`daily_date`, 'D') AS `week_start_date`,
  ROUND(SUM(`a`.`remaining_quantity_d`), 2) AS `remaining_hours`,
  ROUND(SUM(`a`.`quantity_d`), 2) AS `task_allocated_hours`
FROM `pjt_sum_mpp_linear_spread` AS `a`
WHERE
  `a`.`remaining_quantity` > 0
GROUP BY
  `a`.`resource_id`,
  `a`.`project_id`,
  `a`.`task_id`,
  TRUNC(`a`.`daily_date`, 'D')
